display_name.description:
What the invitee wants to be called.

The invitation carries an ADDRESS, not a name, so this is the first
moment a person can state their own name for their own account. Absent
or blank leaves whatever the inviter recorded untouched, so an older
client (or a link opened by someone who did not fill the field in)
changes nothing rather than blanking a name somebody else set.

token.description: The one-time setup token from the invite response.

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

Actor.description:
Who performed the audited action. Append-only provenance record.
Portal variants carry the client-side tier so audit trails distinguish
staff actions from client-portal actions at the storage layer
(actor_kind portal_contact / portal_approver / portal_it_manager).

oneOf.description:
Bulk-import runs (TASKLIST D2): the descriptor names the driving
identity without pretending it row-walked — `"user:<uuid>"` for
admin JWT runs, `"api-key:<key-id>""` for machine pushes. Row-level
mutations still emit their ordinary domain events; the import actor
owns batch-lifecycle provenance (kind "import" in audit storage).

id.description:
Bulk-import runs (TASKLIST D2): the descriptor names the driving
identity without pretending it row-walked — `"user:<uuid>"` for
admin JWT runs, `"api-key:<key-id>""` for machine pushes. Row-level
mutations still emit their ordinary domain events; the import actor
owns batch-lifecycle provenance (kind "import" in audit storage).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key. Absent in
legacy clients — purely additive. (Comments are fresh entities, so
there is no version to match.)

attachment_ids.description:
Attachments uploaded earlier against this ticket (composer flow:
upload first, link when the comment is created). Absent/empty in
older clients — purely additive.

draft_key.description:
IF2 delete-on-submit (Wave 17 lane 11, §5.2): the composer autosave
draft's idempotency key. When a comment with this key commits, the
author's `note_drafts` row for the ticket is deleted in the SAME
transaction — the draft never resurrects after submit. Absent in
legacy clients — purely additive.

oneOf.description:
Per-message greeting/signature the composer wrote (Wave 42). Never a
stored preference. A locked org refuses it: an override is a
personal signature that was never stored, so a workspace that
locked signatures must not be routable around one.

qty_milli.description: Whole units of the member tool (defaults to one unit = 1000 milli).

AddOrderLineRequest.description: POST /purchase-orders/{id}/lines body: the line plus IF1 params.

qty_milli.description:
SIGNED milli delta (negative = shrink). The counter adjustment is
the audit trail, not a rewrite.

AgentProposalView.description: One IF8 proposal with the full snapshot the approval decision needs.

base_version.description: The entity write-seq the proposal was created against.

before_value.description: The value the agent saw (`null` when the record did not exist).

entity.description:
Record coordinates (v1 applies `ticket`/`update` only; the store is
generic).

AgentSkillVersion.description:
One skill VERSION row (the migration-0040 shape + the distribution
columns from migration 0079). History is append-only; rollback
appends a NEW version carrying an old manifest. Enablement rides the
org's active version row — deny-by-default.

enabled.description: Deny-by-default enable gate on the active row.

Aggregate.description:
Aggregation function of a measure. `Count` may omit the column
(`COUNT(*)`); every other aggregate requires one, and the catalog
decides which column types each accepts.

provider.description:
Optional explicit (provider, model) ask — must sit inside the
admin allowlist (an out-of-list ask is REFUSED, never redirected).

warnings.description:
Non-empty when a SOFT cap was crossed: the call proceeds; the
warn also rides an `ai_cap_warn` notification.

personal.description: true when a personal (per-user) credential was selected.

AiCredentialDto.description: Presence-only credential descriptor — never secret material.

AiDecisionOperator.description: How an `ai_decision` condition judges one recorded answer entry.

tokens_by_surface.description: surface → token totals for the period.

models.description:
The admin allowlist this surface resolves against — enabled
catalog entries as (provider, model, label). The per-surface
model pickers list exactly these; the server still refuses an
off-list ask typed (`ai_model_not_allowed`).

oneOf.description:
The caller's recorded sticky pick for this surface (so the picker
displays what sticks); null = the org default still applies.

status.description:
Triage filter (0089): "open" | "acknowledged" | "resolved" —
absent returns all states.

AlertMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response for a triage action (0089). The alert
IS the read-your-write result; `mutation` carries the envelope metadata
(idempotency replay, entity seq).

AlertSeverity.description:
Alert severity vocabulary. Maps onto ticket priorities when an alert
anchors an incident ticket: critical→P1, warning→P2, info→P3.

AlertSourceMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response for a source (IF2). `secret` is the
raw HMAC signing secret — populated ONLY by the create response and
never again (same show-once contract as webhooks/api-keys).

AlertSourceView.description:
An ingest source as the admin surface sees it. The HMAC secret is
NEVER here — it is returned exactly once, in the create response.

event_type.description:
When set, this source is a generic M2M webhook receiver: a signed
POST emits a domain-event envelope onto the outbox stream instead
of creating an alert row (Wave 43 lane 1). NULL = alert source (Wave 9).

payload_schema_ref.description: Payload contract pin; NULL defaults to `core-domain/v1` at ingest.

source_ref.description: Path segment of the ingest URL (public routing id).

AlertView.description: One normalized alert (canonical ingest document + ledger row view).

correlation_key.description: Storm grouping key (defaults to the dedup key server-side).

dedup_key.description: Provider's per-event identity; the replay gate per source.

ApiKeyCreatedResponse.description:
The ONLY response carrying raw key material. Lost keys are rotated by
creating a new key and revoking this one — never recovered.

amount_minor.description:
Allocation amount, minor units; must not exceed the credit's
remaining value.

invoice_id.description: The invoice receiving the allocation (same client + currency).

Appointment.description:
A booked slot on one user's calendar, optionally tied to a ticket and
client/site. `travel_minutes` is travel time booked immediately BEFORE
`starts_at` (Wave 32 lane 7): it ADDS to the appointment and occupies
dispatch capacity (`crate::scheduling::occupied_minutes`), never
replacing or shrinking the booked span. The `travel_*` fields carry
the estimate's provenance so a heuristic number is never mistaken for
a measured one.

scheduling_link_id.description:
Set when the booking came through a Calendly-style scheduling
link (Wave 11 lane 4); NULL for every other creation path.

oneOf.description:
Where the estimate travelled FROM; `None` when no provider
provenance exists (manual minutes or no estimate).

travel_provider.description:
Provider id that produced `travel_minutes` (`none` = built-in
heuristic); `None` for manual values.

AppointmentKind.description:
What an appointment is physically for. Drives rendering color-coding on
calendars and future travel-time logic (on_site only).

AppointmentRequest.description: A client's request for a slot on one staff member's calendar.

appointment_id.description: The real booking created by approval (null until then).

portal_user_id.description: The requesting portal identity (NOT a staff row).

user_id.description: The staff member whose calendar was requested.

oneOf.description: Exact status: `pending | approved | declined | cancelled`.

AppointmentRequestStatus.description:
Lifecycle of an appointment request. `approved`/`declined`/`cancelled`
are terminal; approved requests carry the created appointment's id.

AppointmentStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a booking. `cancelled` frees the slot (the DB exclusion
constraint's partial predicate); `done` still occupies it.

ApprovalStatus.description:
Approval lifecycle of a time entry (Wave 14 lane 1): `draft` entries
are still being worked on, `submitted` waits in the approver queue,
`approved` entries are the only ones billing reads may consume, and
`rejected` entries carry a typed rejection reason until reopened.
Entries consumed by an invoice are additionally LOCKED (enforced by
the persistence layer) regardless of status.

granted_capabilities.description:
Capability keys granted at adopt time (a subset of the staged
manifest's declared set; unknown keys are refused).

ArticleDetail.description:
The single-article read surface (GET): article fields at the top
level plus the sanitized read-only HTML projection the web client
renders server-side — the editor package never ships in bundles that
only read.

client_visible.description: Only articles passing the effective client-facing gate.

q.description: Title substring narrowing; ranked full-text search rides /api/search.

AssetLifecycleInput.description:
Rental tracking + depreciation inputs on an asset (money is integer
minor units + currency code per ADR 0002; no conversion happens here).

AssetMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): asset fields at the top level
plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

group_id.description: `Some(group)` moves the board into that group; `None` ungroups it.

Attachment.description: One uploaded file's metadata row; the payload lives behind `storage_key`.

email_message_id.description: Set only when kind is email_message.

filename.description: Original filename, sanitized (no path components/control chars).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the exact bytes; dedup + integrity anchor.

ticket_comment_id.description: Set only when kind is ticket_comment.

ticket_id.description: Set when kind is ticket_comment or ticket.

uploaded_by_portal_user_id.description:
Portal actor when uploaded through a portal surface (v1: none —
reserved so portal uploads need no schema change).

uploaded_by_user_id.description: Staff uploader when uploaded through the API.

AttachmentDeleted.description:
attachment.deleted — the metadata row went away; `object_removed`
reports whether the backing bytes were reclaimed too (refcount hit 0).

AttachmentKind.description: What an attachment belongs to. The enum value is persisted verbatim.

entity_type.description: Entity type + id the action targeted, when applicable.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when exhausted.

AutomationAction.description:
Effects a rule may request. Every variant maps onto an existing core-api
write path — automations never gain private write routes.

oneOf.description:
§4.6 (Wave 34 lane 4): a plugin-contributed action kind. `entry_key`
names a `plugin_surface_entries` row (`plugin.<slug>.<id>`); the
executor re-reads the registry entry AT EXECUTION TIME — a consented
effect runs only while its install is enabled and the grant stands,
and a missing entry degrades to a typed skip, never a guess.
`params` validate against the entry's `params_schema` before the
effect runs.

AutomationCondition.description:
One predicate; a rule matches only when EVERY condition holds.

Deterministic predicates evaluate against the ticket snapshot; the
[`AutomationCondition::AiDecision`] kind is pulled out by
[`split_conditions`] and evaluated by the worker against recorded
decision answers (ADR 0010 #2).

oneOf.description: Assignee is currently unset.

CSAT surveys on resolution (Wave 34 lane 2): fires only on
`csat.response_recorded` events whose score is BELOW the threshold
(strictly less — threshold 3 fires on 1 and 2). Evaluated against
the event payload score, not the ticket snapshot; on any other
trigger event the condition is a no-match.

Semantic condition answered by the decision model (ADR 0010 §3
#2): references (surface, question, operator, threshold,
confidence-path) and is evaluated by the worker AGAINST THE
NEWEST RECORDED DECISION ANSWERS for the ticket — never by a
live per-rule fan-out (the one-fan-out-per-trigger doctrine is
owned by the worker decision subsystem). Missing/stale answers
evaluate as NO-MATCH with a warn — the exact skip-with-warn
posture a malformed deterministic rule gets today.

confidence_path.description:
Dot-path into the answer entry overriding the default
`"confidence"` key when the rule gates on a specific path.

AutomationTestRunMatch.description:
POST /api/automation-rules/{id}/test-run — dry-run one rule against the
org's most recent tickets (board-scoped when the rule binds a board),
PROPOSAL-shaped: what WOULD match and what the actions would do. The
rule editor renders the result; nothing is ever applied and no event is
emitted — a test-run writes nothing (Wave 17 lane 13 contract: the rule
editor never pretends to execute).

actions_preview.description:
The rule's CURRENT action documents, returned verbatim — the
editor renders them as the proposal preview (never re-derived).

sampled_count.description:
What the run sampled (the org's recent tickets, board-filtered
when the rule binds a board).

user_id.description: Whose windows. Defaults to the caller; another user requires owner/admin.

AvailabilityWindow.description:
One recurring weekly availability template: `weekday` (0 = Monday …
6 = Sunday), local wall-clock `[start_local, end_local)` in `timezone`,
optionally bounded by an effective date range. This is a TEMPLATE —
occurrences are computed, never stored.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the wall-clock bounds live in.

oneOf.description:
The per-candidate audit row for accepts (each merge is individually
undoable via its split endpoint).

staged_chunks.description:
Async giant-batch bookkeeping (D2 remainder): staged chunk count and
the once-only worker-enqueue stamp.

BillingCandidateLine.description:
One draft invoice-line candidate. This is a PREVIEW shape: nothing
persists until Wave 9's invoice run.

amount_minor.description:
Line total in minor units (currency on the parent evaluation).
NEGATIVE only for `sla_credit` lines — the one line kind whose
signed amount is meaningful; everything else is ≥ 0 and the
engine's i128 total fold accepts the mix.

period_start.description:
The billing period (recurring/retainer) or the effective slice of
the evaluation window (T&M) or the fee's due date mirrored into
both ends (fixed fee). Inclusive start, exclusive end for
period-derived lines.

quantity_minutes.description: Labor minutes on the line (T&M/overage); 0 for amount lines.

unit_amount_minor.description:
Unit price in minor units: the hourly rate for labor lines, the
full amount otherwise.

BillingEvaluation.description: The result of evaluating one contract's billing rules over a window.

oneOf.description: Block draw-down detail (prepaid blocks only; empty otherwise).

cap_warnings.description:
Cap warnings (`warn` behavior): one human-readable marker per
(cap, period) whose labor reached the cap. `stop`/`overage_billable`
communicate through their line shapes instead.

total_minor.description: Sum of line amounts, minor units.

BillingFrequency.description:
Billing period length. Period boundaries derive from the contract's
`billing_anchor`: the anchor is the first period's start date and each
subsequent period starts one frequency step later (calendar-aware
clamping lives in core-billing's period arithmetic).

BillingLineKind.description: Which billing rule produced a candidate line.

BillingMethod.description:
How the project turns delivered work into money. The value rides the
milestone event payload so core-billing can route without re-reading the
project row (event payloads are additive-only, policy §2).

BlockConsumption.description:
The per-period consumption summary a block contract's evaluation
carries back: draws in order, blocks that expired unused inside the
window (for depletion/expiry alerts), and any minutes that found no
open block (`unblocked_minutes` — they bill as T&M).

BlockDrawView.description: One draw: which entry consumed how many block minutes.

BlockPanelView.description:
The retainer / prepaid block-consumption panel (report V7): which
entries drew the included block versus billed as overage, the
remaining balance, and the depletion alert.

draws.description: Per-entry draws: which entries consumed the block.

expires_on.description: Expiry, when the block carries one.

overage_minutes.description:
Minutes of this window's work that found no open block — they
bill at card rates (the overage the admin must see).

prior_drawn_minutes.description: Minutes drawn BEFORE this window (earlier runs).

BlockSpec.description: Prepaid-block spec (A): an hour bank sold up front.

block_rate_minor.description: Optional discounted draw-down rate, minor units per hour.

created_at.description: Users whose favorite this board is (board groups/favorites, Stage 2).

require_checklist_close.description:
Pre-close checklist enforcement toggle (defaults OFF; closing is
gated only when this AND a checklist template are both present —
defaults-first doctrine, migration 0016).

BoardGroup.description:
A named, ordered nav grouping of boards within one org (TASKLIST 2.11).
Groups are organization-wide; `owner_id` records who controls the group.

BoardMember.description:
An explicit per-user membership on one board carrying a board-level
role tier (§6 board-level RBAC). Rows NARROW org grants; absence of a
row leaves org-level governance untouched.

BoardNavEntry.description: One left-nav entry: the board plus the CALLER's annotations.

favorite.description: Whether THIS user favorited the board (star).

group_id.description: Group assignment for the collapsible tree (`None` = ungrouped).

oneOf.description: The caller's board role (`None` = no membership row ⇒ org-governed).

BoardRole.description:
Per-board role tier stored on `board_members` rows (migration 0019,
TASKLIST 2.11). Board roles sit BESIDE the org matrix and can only
narrow it — see `authorize_board_scoped`.

BoardStatus.description:
A per-board status. `category` is the binding contract — labels are
presentation, category is behavior.

client_visible.description:
Wave 41 lane 12: whether the portal shows this status's own label to
a client. `false` shows the semantic category word instead, so an
internal label ("Escalated to L2") never reaches a client while the
ticket still reports where it stands.

is_entry.description: Whether tickets may enter this status directly from New.

wip_limit.description:
Per-column WIP cap (0089): occupancy of this column is enforced
server-side at ticket status change. `None` = no limit.

BoardStatusUsage.description:
GET /api/boards/{id}/statuses/usage — per-status ticket counts and
automation references (Wave 41 lane 12).

One read serves both the settings table's TICKETS column and the delete
confirm's "12 tickets use this status" and "2 automations mention this
status", so the table and the confirm can never quote different numbers for
the same status.

automation_count.description:
Automation rules naming this status. They are PAUSED, never silently
repointed, if the status is deleted.

ticket_count.description:
Tickets currently in this status, closed ones included: the column is
where work has been, not a live queue.

BoardTransitionsResponse.description:
GET response for a board's workflow: either its explicit matrix or the
marker that the semantic-category floor governs.

mode.description:
`"explicit"` when the listed edges are authoritative; `"floor"` when
the semantic-category default governs (any→any except closed→open).

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): debounce/retry safe.

starts_at.description:
Slot start (the template's duration extends it). Must sit fully
inside ONE free interval of the scope at book time.

BulkDecisionItem.description:
Per-item outcome of a bulk decision: applied entries carry the new
snapshot; refused entries name exactly why (not-in-queue, locked, or
not visible in scope), so the client flags rows instead of guessing.

reason.description:
Typed refusal reason on `refused` rows (validation/unique/key
reuse); never carries secret material.

created.description: Convenience counts for the driver loop.

rows_per_sec_ceiling.description:
True when the caller should send another chunk (informational —
the driver knows its own queue; the row ceiling is the pacing
signal to stay under).

fields.description: Material fields — sealed with coordinate AAD before persistence.

idempotency_key.description:
Stable per-row idempotency key — THE resume checkpoint. Generate
once per source row (e.g. the legacy row's stable id) and reuse it
verbatim on every chunk retry.

BusinessCalendar.description:
Weekly business hours in a named IANA timezone, plus holiday dates.
`None` window = non-business day.

holidays.description: Local dates (YYYY-MM-DD) with no business hours.

maintenance.description:
Downtime stretches subtracted from every measurement. Absent in
legacy documents (`default`) so stored policies keep deserializing.

ByokOverviewResponse.description: Summary of all configured AI providers for the org.

ByokSecretMutationResponse.description:
Mutation response: status fields plus the instant-first mutation
metadata (`mutation.version` echoes into the next write).

ByokSecretStatus.description:
Non-secret status of a stored BYOK key (presence flags only — never
key material). Flattened into mutation responses so a stored replay
deserializes byte-identically.

Cadence.description: The typed cadence of a schedule row (the stored slug's Rust shape).

CadenceSpec.description:
The typed cadence + wall-clock shape (same columns as report
schedules; the DB CHECKs pin the same consistency rules).

timezone.description: IANA zone the wall clock reads in.

CalendarDeadlineEntry.description: One deadline the overlay renders. Hydration lives in the row.

category.description: Semantic category (informational — closed tickets never arrive).

CalendarExclusion.description: Absolute UTC time-off punching holes in availability.

CalendarItem.description:
Flat merged entry so calendars render one ordered list without caring
which table produced it.

oneOf.description: Appointment-only fields.

travel_minutes.description:
Appointment-only (Wave 32 lane 7): booked travel minutes sitting
immediately BEFORE the appointment — the calendar renders them
visually distinct from the booking block.

CalendarSyncConnection.description: One external-calendar connection for one user's calendar.

external_account.description:
The provider's own account id (Google `sub`, Microsoft `oid`).
Recorded so an operator auditing a sync can tell WHICH account the
connection is bound to. Not an identity Marula authenticates with.

feed_path.description:
Outbound: relative feed path clients render against the API
origin; the raw token itself is never readable again.

feed_url.description: Inbound: the external iCal URL the provider polls.

last_error.description: Last poll failure message (fixed provider-side copy, no internals).

last_synced_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last successful poll.

provider.description: The provider seam discriminator ('ical' is the first-party provider).

scopes.description:
Scopes actually granted, recorded so the consent screen and the
stored grant can be compared. Never widened after consent.

token_expires_at.description:
Expiry of `access_token`. CHECK-paired with the token so a token row
can never be read as valid-forever.

CalendarSyncDirection.description:
What a connection does: `outbound` serves the org's appointments to
the external calendar (private token-scoped iCal feed), `inbound`
polls the external feed for busy time, `two_way` does both.

CalendarSyncEvent.description:
The inbound mirror of one external event. `exclusion_id` names the
`calendar_exclusions` row the event currently feeds into the 2.12
availability foundation (NULL while not busy — cancelled or transparent).

external_uid.description: The external event's UID — the duplicate key per connection.

sequence.description: Highest external sequence wins on re-poll.

CalendarSyncStatus.description:
Connection health: `error` records the last poll failure while the
connection stays configured; writes resume when a poll succeeds.

availability_windows.description: Present on personal views only (templates are per-user).

items.description: Merged appointments + on-call, ordered by starts_at then id.

CapReachedBehavior.description:
What evaluation does when a T&M contract's cap is reached (B: never a
silent cutoff — the behavior is a typed choice on the cap).

CapSpec.description: NTE cap spec (B): typed not-to-exceed behavior.

work_type.description: Optional work_type bucket the cap covers (`None` = all labor).

CapabilityGrantView.description: One granted capability with its dial position.

CapabilityMode.description: Wire involvement-dial position of a capability grant.

CapacityForecastEntryView.description:
One technician's line in the forecast: committed project load beside
booked appointments.

available_percent_days.description:
The window's total available percent-days for this technician, from
their availability windows minus calendar exclusions. Zero means the
technician has no declared availability in the window, which is a
different state from being fully booked and must not render as 100%.

committed_percent_days.description:
Committed project load in PERCENT-DAYS. 200.0 = "100% of one
technician's time for two days", or two phases at 100% for one day.
A plain percentage would flatten a month-long 20% plan and a
week-long 80% plan into the same number, and they are not the same
commitment.

utilization.description:
`committed / available`, or `None` when availability is zero. A
ratio with a zero denominator is the classic way a forecast reports
"infinite overload" for a technician nobody scheduled.

CapacityForecastView.description:
The forecast-shaped read model: committed project load per technician
across a window, which is what `/dispatch/capacity` could never show
because it only knew about appointments.

CapacityHorizonView.description:
The assembled horizon payload. `unassigned_count` is the current open
unassigned queue depth so planners see demand next to capacity.

CapacityQuery.description:
GET /api/dispatch/capacity query: `from` date (defaults to today UTC)
and the horizon length in days (1..=31, default 7).

CaptureDefaultsResponse.description: The capture surface's read: ordered picker + theHELP defaults.

categories.description: Non-retired categories ordered by position (the picker).

work_type_map.description:
The backfill/manual mapping (legacy value → slug) so capture
surfaces can normalize pasted free text honestly.

CatalogColumn.description:
One catalog column: the static identifier plus its value class slug
(`uuid | text | timestamp | date | int | bigint | bool`). The slug is
what the builder UI keys operand typing on.

CatalogItemMutationResponse.description: Instant-first mutation response (IF2) for catalog mutations.

CatalogItemView.description:
RB2 (ADR 0004): a catalog item as the CALLER may see it. `unit_price`
is the commercial surface; `cost_minor` (and the gross margin derived
from it) is financial data — it serializes `null` for callers without
`financial:read` (dispatchers and technicians by default), which is
the "those values render blank" rule. The write trail keeps full
fidelity server-side; only client-facing views redact.

CatalogView.description:
The field catalog of ONE versioned view: every projected column plus the
narrower filterable inventory. Identifiers here are the ONLY ones a
builder may reference — the server re-validates every spec against the
same Rust catalog at save and run time.

CategoryMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): category fields at the top level
plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

messages.description:
The conversation so far (system prompt first). The client owns the
transcript; the runner persists none of it.

provider.description:
Optional explicit (provider, model) ask — must sit inside the
admin allowlist, exactly like the authorize edge.

session_opener.description:
True only on a session's first turn — the
`ai.chat_session_started` event rides that turn alone.

ticket_id.description:
`ticket_note_assist` only: the ticket the assist drafts against
(the IF8 proposal target).

lines.description: Lines to return; empty/absent = every outstanding unit.

to_location_id.description: Where the tools land; absent = the checkout's own location.

ChecklistItem.description:
One line of a ticket's pre-close checklist. Items instantiated from the
board's template carry `template_item_id`; those are REQUIRED when the
board enforces pre-close checklists (see `crate::notes`). Ad-hoc items
(`template_item_id == None`) never block closure.

na.description:
Shared "not applicable" state (Wave 12 lane 6): server truth for the
tasks-panel tri-state, set by the toggle endpoint in the same tx as
`checked`. Mutually exclusive with `checked` (enforced at the API);
N-A REQUIRED items are exempt from pre-close enforcement and derived
progress. `#[serde(default)]` keeps older payloads (no `na` key)
deserializing as false — additive-only contract.

ChecklistProgress.description:
Derived-at-read-time checklist progress (never materialized — see the
0016 migration header for the justification). `required_open` counts
unchecked template-derived instances: the close-blocking set when the
board enforces.

ChecklistTemplate.description:
A board's pre-close checklist template. Exactly one per board
(UNIQUE in storage): the deterministic gate consulted at close time.

ChecklistTemplateItem.description:
One required step in a template. Instances on tickets link back to this
id (`checklist_items.template_item_id`), so enforcement follows identity,
never fragile text matching.

ChecklistTemplateView.description:
GET /api/boards/{id}/checklist-template response: the template (if any),
its items, and the enforcement posture actually applied at close time.

overdue_only.description: Only open checkouts past their due date.

template_id.description: Optional saved field-mapping template applied before validation.

ChunkSummaryWire.description:
u32-friendly mirror of [`core_domain::import_core::ChunkSummary`] so the
generated SDK gets plain integers without overflow caveats.

CiInterface.description: A NIC attribute of a config item (ADR 0003 lifecycle rule).

CiMerge.description: An audited, undoable merge (the split substrate).

CiMergeCandidate.description:
A reviewable ambiguous match (ADR 0003): visible evidence, one-click
accept/reject, auto-merge only above the org threshold.

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

CiMergeStatus.description:
CI4: lifecycle of a reviewable merge candidate. `deferred` parks a
candidate out of the pending queue without deciding it (the workbench's
batch defer; reversible — a feed upsert re-activates it via upsert).

CiSemanticClass.description:
CI6: a semantic class is the behavior-bearing identity of a CI type.
Layouts (types) are org-configurable and renameable; the class is not.

token.description: The one-time token, verbatim from the create response.

restricted_to.description:
Optional per-client visibility: when set, only these users (plus
admins) can see the client. Empty = all org members.

ClientCompletenessView.description:
The backend documentation-completeness read model — the weights live
here; the web card renders the facts.

basis.description: One human sentence, honest about the untouched legs (n/a).

score.description:
0..=100, pro-rated over the legs the facts CAN speak about
(never a silent zero and never a padded 100).

ClientCsatRollup.description:
One client's CSAT rollup over the window (responses scored 1-5;
"low" = score ≤ 2).

device_asset_id.description:
The device's row in the client's fleet (instantiated on issue for
stock-sourced devices; ADR 0003 identity keys converge later feeds).

from_stock.description: True when the device came from org stock (rode the ledger).

overdue.description: Derived: open past the expected return date.

ClientMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): client fields at the top level
(unchanged shape) plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

ClientOrgMap.description:
The durable operator mapping a reconciliation accept writes: one row
per (source system, vendor org id), pointing at one Marula client.

ClientOverrideRow.description:
The stored client row, as provenance on a resolved entry (who last set it
and when — the audit subject; the append-only trail keeps the full history).

ClientWorkflowResolution.description:
The client's full resolved workflow: one entry per registry declaration,
registry order preserved.

oneOf.description:
Optional taxonomy filter (`internal`, `client_visible`,
`in_house_update`). Omit for all kinds (staff view).

CommittedChunkRef.description: One committed chunk's position in the resume view.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.

task_ids.description:
Checklist items to complete. Items already checked/N-A are skipped
(idempotent); unknown ids 404 the whole call (batch atomicity).

CompleteAllRequest.description:
POST /api/tickets/{id}/checklist/complete-all request (Wave 17 lane 11
§5.3): the close gate's Option A batch — every listed item flips to
`checked` and each lands its auto-append note, ALL in one transaction
with per-item idempotency keys (duplicate-proof at the envelope, scored
as REPORTED auto notes via `workflow_meta.auto = true`).

CompletenessGap.description: One named scoring leg that couldn't earn its weight.

key.description:
Stable vocabulary the web card maps to copy (same keys the client
lane's card used — the render contract did not move).

semantic_class.description: The layout's CI6 semantic class (None = untyped).

ConfigSourceLink.description:
A feeder's per-source record link (ADR 0003). 0..N per config item; the
unique key is `(org, source_system, external_id)`.

exclude_appointment_id.description: Appointment excluded from the check (its own id when rescheduling).

ConflictPolicy.description:
Per-entity conflict semantics when an external key already maps to a
live row whose content differs from the incoming spec.

ConflictView.description: One blocking booking named by the dry-run.

feed_token.description:
The raw outbound feed token — returned ONLY here (creation) and
by the rotate endpoint. Never readable again afterwards.

ConnectorAppointment.description: One booking as the connector sees it.

oneOf.description: Latest pushed field-service status, when any.

installed.description: Installed connectors (typed kinds only, presence summaries).

config.description:
Provider configuration document — WHOLESALE sealed (never
logged, never echoed). The adapters expect, per kind:
slack/teams `{ "webhook_url": "https://…" }`,
rewst `{ "webhook_url": "https://…", "secret": "…" }`,
voip `{ "access_token": "…", "provider": "…" }`.

ConnectorProfile.description:
ADR 0009 §6 (Wave 19 lane 2): the modeled connector governance
profile — WHERE the connector speaks (webhook endpoints) and what it
wears outward (SaaS scopes). Structured, validated DECLARATIONS, not
prose: the consent screen renders them verbatim and connectors inherit
the platform's egress posture from the declared endpoint list.

oneOf.description:
Wave 32 lane 7 (ADR 0014): present when the pack answers the
Marula Routing Contract endpoints (`/routing/matrix`, …). The
declaration mirrors the operator config 1:1 so consent shows
exactly what the adapter will honor.

scopes.description:
The outbound scopes the connector asks the upstream SaaS for
(e.g. `graph:mail.read`); opaque strings to the core — they exist
for consent-time visibility and install-record provenance, max 32.

webhook_endpoints.description:
The webhook URLs traffic from the platform sends toward. https-only
absolute URLs, host required, no credentials in the URL, max 8.

ConnectorScheduleQuery.description:
GET /api/dispatch-connector/schedule query. The window is bounded at
62 days so one pull cannot scan the whole calendar.

ConnectorStatusView.description: The latest status push for one booking.

skills.description:
Current (non-expired) skills — lets the external planner respect
certifications before proposing a dispatch.

ConsentView.description:
The consent screen payload — ONE component shared by every source
(same shape the update re-consent flow shows).

connector_profile.description:
ADR 0009 §6 full semantics — the modeled connector governance
profile (webhook endpoints + scopes) when the manifest declared
one, for verbatim consent rendering.

surface_profile.description:
§4.6 (Wave 34 lane 4) — the declarative UI-surface profile
(widgets / automation action kinds / report render kinds /
field validators), rendered on consent verbatim so an admin
consents to exactly the surfaces the plugin contributes.

qty_milli.description: MILLI to consume (positive; the ledger stores it negative).

ticket_id.description: The on-site job consuming the parts (traceability anchor).

merged_into_id.description:
Merge tombstone: when set, this row was folded into the target and
only its audit row keeps it queryable.

observed_fields.description:
CI5 tiers generalized to contacts (ADR 0003 extension): observed
feed-written fields, human-curated sticky fields, per-field source
provenance. Empty maps for pre-0101 rows.

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

Contract.description:
A commercial agreement with one client. Money fields are integer minor
units (cents for USD) — floats are forbidden near amounts (§5).

billing_anchor.description: Required for recurring/retainer; the first billing period's start.

oneOf.description: Required for recurring/retainer; the period cadence.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; every amount on the contract uses this currency.

effective_from.description: First day the agreement can generate billable candidates.

hourly_rate_minor.description:
Default hourly rate for T&M when no rate card row matches the
entry's `work_type`, minor units per hour.

incident_price_minor.description:
Per-incident: the fixed price per closed ticket in the covered
band, minor units.

incident_priority.description:
Per-incident: which closed tickets price — the four-tier priority
(`p1|p2|p3|p4`), or `any` for every closed ticket. `NULL` = any.

included_minutes.description: Retainer: labor minutes included in each period's base price.

notes.description:
Per-ticket capped bands (T&M, retainer, per-incident on the same
contract type is fine too): when set, evaluation enforces the cap.
Stored denormalized from `contract_caps` for read-path simplicity
(the cap rows carry the authoritative state).

number.description: Human contract number, unique per org (e.g. "C-2026-014").

overage_rate_minor.description: Retainer: hourly rate for minutes beyond the included block.

po_number.description:
Client purchase-order reference printed on the invoices this
contract produces (F: PO number rides the contract so runs carry
it forward without per-invoice entry).

oneOf.description:
Per-unit recurring: which inventory counts the units — `devices`
(device_assets for the client) or `users` (org users billed to the
client's contract). Defaults to `devices` at evaluation when unset.

unit_price_minor.description: Per-unit recurring: the price per unit per period, minor units.

ContractBlock.description:
A prepaid block (hour bank): sold up front, drawn down on use, with
expiry + rollover policies (A). Rows are immutable once sold —
rollover MINTS a successor block at expiry, it never edits the old
row (additive-ledger doctrine).

block_rate_minor.description:
Optional discounted hourly rate for labor priced against this
block; `None` bills draws at the card/default rate with the block
absorbing the minutes (a pure prepaid balance).

created_at.description:
Draw-down ledger: each consumption row subtracts from the block.
The remaining balance is computed, never stored.

expires_on.description: Last day draws may land inside this block.

rollover_policy.description:
`expire` — unused minutes lapse at expiry; `rollover` — unused
minutes mint a successor block (12 months) at expiry; `none` —
no expiry, draws allowed indefinitely.

sale_price_minor.description: Sale price, minor units (usually total_minutes/60 × block rate).

ContractCap.description:
A T&M not-to-exceed cap. `scope` picks the boundary:
`period` enforces per billing period, `contract` enforces over the
contract's whole effective window.

cap_minor.description: The not-to-exceed amount, minor units of billable work per scope.

overage_rate_minor.description:
Hourly rate for `overage_billable` beyond the cap; `None` bills
the matched card/default rate.

reached_behavior.description: What happens when the cap is reached (typed, never silent).

work_type.description: Optional work_type filter: the cap applies only to that bucket.

ContractChangeOrder.description:
An approved change order: a billable amendment with its own lifecycle
(E). Riding existing approval/audit patterns: statuses
`draft → approved → billed`, rejected/cancelled terminal.

change_orders.description:
Lifecycle aggregates ride as counts on the detail (their own
surfaces list them; this keeps the aggregate view honest about
attached commercial state).

minimum_commitment_minor.description: Per-period minimum commitment, minor units (`None` = none).

ContractDetail.description:
The contract aggregate as one view: the agreement plus its rate card,
fee schedule, prepaid blocks, and caps.

ContractEscalator.description:
A scheduled escalator: the contract's per-period price uplifts by
`uplift_bps` basis points each anniversary of the billing anchor
(E). Pure math at evaluation — no state.

first_uplift_on.description:
First anniversary that applies (defaults to evaluation at the
anchor itself when `None` — the anchor anniversary).

ContractFixedFee.description:
Fixed-fee schedule entry: becomes a candidate line when `due_on` falls
inside the evaluation window (and the effective window).

effective_on.description: Only contracts effective on this date.

ContractMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): contract aggregate at the top
level plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

ContractRate.description:
T&M rate card row: the hourly rate for time entries whose `work_type`
matches `work_type`. Entries with no matching row bill at the
contract's default `hourly_rate_minor`.

ContractSlaCredit.description:
An SLA service credit the admin or verification flow applies for a
missed SLA (E): becomes a NEGATIVE `sla_credit` line at the next
run window covering `applies_on`. Never silent — the record names
the ticket, the policy, and the missed target.

amount_minor.description:
Credit amount, minor units — stored POSITIVE, applied as a
negative line (the ledger records magnitude; direction is the
line kind's meaning).

applies_on.description:
The billing window the credit lands in (inclusive-day semantics
at evaluation: `from <= applies_on <= to`).

reason.description: What was missed ("resolution target breached by 2d 4h").

ContractStatus.description:
Lifecycle. `draft` contracts evaluate in previews (plan before
activation) but Wave 9's invoice runs will refuse them; `cancelled`
contracts never evaluate. `ended` keeps evaluating candidates whose
dates fall inside the (closed) effective window.

ContractType.description:
The supported commercial agreement shapes. Wave 39 adds the MSP
relationship types beyond the original four: per-unit recurring
(per-seat / per-device) and per-incident (per closed ticket) pricing.
Prepaid blocks, NTE caps, minimums, and escalators ride the existing
types as attached configuration rather than new shapes.

ConvertQuoteResponse.description: Convert-to-invoice response: the quote with its seam targets.

CostLineKind.description: One money line on a ticket: `parts`, `flat`, or `other`.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1) — idempotency key.

client_id.description: Optional client context stamped onto created incident tickets.

event_type.description:
When set, this source is a generic M2M webhook receiver that emits
domain-event envelopes onto the outbox stream instead of creating
alert rows (Wave 43 lane 1). Leave NULL for the classic alert path.

payload_schema_ref.description:
Payload contract pin (e.g. `"acme-io/webhook-v1"`); NULL defaults
to `core-domain/v1`. Advisory — the ingest envelope always carries
the resolved schema ref.

source_ref.description:
Optional custom routing id (3–64 chars of `[a-z0-9-]`); generated
when absent. Globally unique — collisions are a typed 409.

oneOf.description: Defaults to on_site when omitted.

travel_minutes.description: Dispatch placeholder, stored verbatim (RoutingProvider comes later).

user_id.description:
Assignee whose calendar holds the slot. Defaults to the caller;
booking for someone else requires owner/admin.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

client_visible.description:
Portal v2 gate: effective client visibility additionally requires a
published status and a client-visible category (core_kb rule).

content_jsonb.description:
Canonical rich content (ADR 0007): the versioned Tiptap-JSON
envelope `{"schema_ver": 1, "doc": <tiptap-doc>}`. Validated
server-side on write; when present it WINS over `body` (the
plain-text projection is derived deterministically).

slug.description: Stable per-org handle; derived from the title when omitted.

to_kind.description: One of: document | password | client | ticket | kb_article | asset.

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

client_id.description: Required for client-scoped assets; absent for internal-org ones.

layout_id.description: Typed layout; when set, `fields` is validated against its schema.

oneOf.description:
Inventory lifecycle inputs (rental tracking + depreciation,
migration 0061); all optional, absent = SQL default.

scope.description:
client | internal_org (migration 0103). Defaults to `client` when
a client_id is present — internal-org assets (the MSP's own gear)
carry no client, never a fake one.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the wall-clock bounds live in.

user_id.description:
Whose calendar. Defaults to the caller; another user requires
owner/admin.

CreateBatchRequest.description:
POST /api/imports/batches — opens a committed-run span. Chunks then land
through `/chunks` (synchronous) or `/stage` + `/run` (async, D2
remainder) until the batch finishes.

unit.description: Unit of measure the price applies to (default `each`).

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

client_visible.description:
Portal v2 gate: only categories with this flag can expose articles
to client users.

slug.description: Stable per-org handle; derived from the name when omitted.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1). (Creates carry no version.)

due_at.description: When the tools are due back (RFC 3339).

items.description:
Individual tools; an absent serial auto-picks the oldest in-stock
unit at the checkout location.

kit_id.description: Set for a whole-kit (toolbox) checkout; `items` must then be empty.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key. Absent in
legacy clients — purely additive. (Creates carry no version.)

feed_url.description: Required for inbound/two_way: the external iCal URL to poll.

provider.description: Provider discriminator; 'ical' is the only one today.

user_id.description:
Whose calendar. Defaults to the caller; another user requires
owner/admin.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key. Absent
in legacy clients — purely additive. (Creates carry no version.)

billing_anchor.description: Required for recurring/retainer; first billing period's start.

oneOf.description: Required for recurring/retainer.

blocks.description: Prepaid hour banks (only valid on T&M and retainer contracts).

caps.description: NTE caps (only valid on time_and_materials contracts).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code (e.g. "USD"); every amount uses this currency.

oneOf.description: Scheduled escalator (E); `None` = none.

fees.description: Fee schedule (only valid on fixed_fee contracts).

hourly_rate_minor.description: T&M default hourly rate, minor units.

incident_price_minor.description: Per-incident (D): fixed price per closed ticket.

overage_rate_minor.description: Retainer hourly overage rate, minor units.

po_number.description: Client PO reference printed on produced invoices (F).

rates.description: T&M rate card (only valid on time_and_materials contracts).

oneOf.description: Defaults to `draft`.
Per-unit recurring (C): `devices|users`.

unit_price_minor.description: Per-unit recurring (C): price per unit per period.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

layout_id.description: Typed layout; when set, `fields` is validated against its schema.

email.description: The identity's email, recorded for audit/display only.

subject.description: The edge assertion's `sub` (Cloudflare Access user id).

user_id.description:
Local Marula user to bind. The admin is the verified-email
authority here: linking asserts "this local account is this
edge identity".

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

fetch.description: Fetch the provider title now; empty when the fetch is skipped.

url.description:
Must resolve against the allowlist — a create with an unmatched
URL is a typed 422, never a stored row.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

article_id.description:
Optional attachment to one KB article. When attached, the row
rides that article's client-facing gate for portal reads.

permission_note.description:
Who may open the link and what they need (e.g. "M365 group
ACME-IT"). Documentation of access, never enforcement.

url.description:
Absolute https URL; SharePoint/OneDrive/Drive-class hosts are
classified server-side — the client cannot lie about the kind.

line_id.description: PO-line links only: the line inside the route's order.

validator_entry_key.description:
§4.6: registry key of a plugin field_validator entry
(`plugin.<slug>.<id>`); stored in config and enforced on every
value write (fail-closed when the entry disappears).

mapping.description:
Source column → canonical Marula column. Targets are validated
against the canonical field catalog for the entity kind.

name.description: Operator-facing template name (unique per source system + kind).

source_system.description: Source-system label this template belongs to (e.g. "connectwise").

mac.description: Normalized to lower colon form server-side.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key.

client_id.description: Restrict the run to one client's billable contracts.

due_in_days.description: Payment terms for the issued invoices, in days (default 30).

CreateLabelTemplateRequest.description:
Create body. `width_mm`/`height_mm` are required exactly when
`size_preset = "custom"`; millimetres are rounded to a tenth.

slug.description: Stable handle; derived from the name when absent.

to_kind.description: One of: document | password | client | ticket | kb_article | asset.

number.description: Absent → generated `PO-NNNNNN` from the org sequence.

notes.description: Encrypted at rest; returned only through the reveal endpoint.

rotate_at.description: Rotation schedule (Wave 19 lane 3): absent/null = never remide.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

budget_minor.description:
Wave 39 lane 4 (report C/D): the phase's billing budget and/or the
fixed fee a COMPLETED non-milestone phase releases. Milestone
phases keep using `milestone_amount_*`.

start_date.description:
The planned window (Wave 34 claims close-out, claim 6). Both ends
optional: a phase created without dates lands in the ordered list,
NOT on the Gantt, and the UI says which it is. Supplying only one
end is rejected at the database CHECK, because a phase with a start
and no length has no bar to draw.

password.description:
Initial credential, hashed with argon2id before storage. The admin
delivers it to the contact out-of-band (v1 has no invite email).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

billing_contract_id.description:
The contract this project bills through (Wave 39 lane 4, report
P2). Its rate card/blocks/caps price the project's T&M entries and
its runs carry the project's released milestones. Validated to
belong to the same client.

agent_ref.description:
Agent provenance (§5). Optional: the machine identity defaults to
the caller's (`api-key:<id>` / `user:<id>`).

before_value.description:
The value the agent saw when it drafted the change (the IF8
before-snapshot). `null` for creates. Application re-reads the
live entity, so this is decision context, not a blind write.

capability.description: Write capability this change belongs to (must be granted).

for_user.description: The user the agent acted on behalf of.

rule_set_hash.description: Hash of the evaluated rule set at proposal time.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

oembed_endpoint.description: oEmbed endpoint template; exactly one `{url}` placeholder, https.

slug.description: Stable per-org handle; derived from the name when omitted.

url_regex.description: Regex over the full resource URL (Rust regex syntax).

source_note.description: Free-form note about the third-party source system.

tax_rate_bps.description: Flat tax rate over the TAXABLE subtotal, basis points (800 = 8%).

name.description: Org-unique display name (1–200 chars after trimming).

oneOf.description:
Requested visibility; `org` requires admin and non-admins are
forced onto `self` regardless.

name.description: Org-unique display name (1–200 chars after trimming).

recipients.description: Recipient staff users of this org (1–50).

report_definition_id.description: The stored R3 definition this schedule delivers.

timezone.description: IANA zone the wall clock reads in.

subject_kind.description:
What the rule's subject is: `ticket` (default, historical) or
`board` — a rule that fires on ticket-less envelopes (Wave 43
lane 3).

expires_at.description:
Absolute expiry (lifecycle signal); absent = stays valid until
used or revoked.

ticket_id.description: Bookings made through this link land back on this ticket.

query.description:
The query that produced the result (2..=256 chars — the same bounds
GET /api/search enforces), snapshotted on the pin.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

fields.description: Material fields — sealed with coordinate AAD before persistence.

rotate_at.description:
Rotation schedule (Wave 19 lane 3): the worker sweep reminds once
past this instant (at-most-once per schedule).

expires_at.description:
RFC 3339 instant; the server typed-refuses dates in the past or
absurdly far out (> 90 days — a share link is a bounded window,
not a chronic credential).

label.description:
Optional provenance shown to link managers and the audit trail
("kiosk roll-out window", …). Secrets NEVER belong here — the
audit stores detail, never material.

cert_fingerprint.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the client certificate to pin.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry; must be in the future when provided.

scopes.description: Permission-grant keys (validated against the policy matrix).

captured_at.description: Device-clock reading when the stroke finished. Recorded verbatim.

consent_id.description:
Optional explicit consent id — pins the exact wording row when the
pad fetched it before a concurrent revision landed.

consent_version.description:
Consent wording version the signer saw. The server rejects an
unknown version so a stale pad cannot capture against wording the
signer never read.

idempotency_key.description: Client-minted replay anchor (offline queue). Enforced unique per org.

image_base64.description: Base64 PNG of the trimmed, ink-only mark.

signer_kind.description: Reserved for the portal path; rejected today.

signer_name.description: Who signed, as they typed it on the pad.

supersedes_sign_off_id.description: Set only when this capture corrects an earlier sign-off.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1). (Creates carry no version.)

reason.description:
What was missed — printed on the credit line verbatim ("resolution
target breached by 2d 4h"). Required: a silent credit is exactly
the failure mode the ledger refuses.

oneOf.description: `open|won|lost` (default `open`).

category.description:
The semantic category this status binds to — behavior (SLA pauses,
billing, automations) reads the category, never the label (§5).

wip_limit.description:
Optional per-column WIP cap (0089). 1..=1000 — the DB CHECK is the
backstop; this route validates before the write.

catalog_item_id.description:
Soft catalog link when a catalog line exists; absent = free-form
part (name/part_number carry the identity).

is_tool.description:
Wave 32 lane 3: flag the item as a tool (serialized-only, eligible
for tool checkout + kit membership).

last_unit_cost_minor.description:
Optional opening cost reference at create (display only; locked
costs land with receive legs).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

depends_on.description:
Finish-to-start dependencies to create with the task; every id must
be a task of the SAME project. Cycles are impossible at creation
(nothing can depend on the not-yet-existing task) but membership is
validated.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key. Fresh
entities have no version to match.

parent_id.description:
Subcategory parent (categories only): must be a ROOT category of
this org — the tree is exactly two levels deep.

spec.description:
Versioned template spec (core-projects `template`, spec_version 1).
Validated eagerly so broken blueprints never persist.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

custom_fields.description:
Initial custom-field values; each is validated against its
definition. REQUIRED definitions must all be present (TASKLIST 2.17).

phase_id.description: Project-scoped variant (exactly one of ticket_id / phase_id).

ticket_id.description:
The ticket this entry bills through. `None` ONLY for project-scoped
entries (Wave 39 lane 4, report P5): supply `phase_id` instead and
the entry bills through the phase project's linked contract.

unbillable_reason.description: Typed unbillable reason — required when `billable` is false (V3).

work_type.description: Category slug from the org's time taxonomy (Wave 39 V5).

appointment_id.description:
Wave 32 lane 7: the planned appointment this trip reconciles
against (optional — ad-hoc travel against a ticket stays legal).

user_id.description:
Whose work this is; defaults to the caller. Only owner/admin may
file on someone else's behalf.

amount_minor.description: Overrides the computed reimbursement amount when present.

spec.description:
Versioned, additive-only view spec (filter/group/sort). Consumers
tolerate unknown fields.

event_types.description: Exact event types to subscribe; empty subscribes to everything.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint receiving `POST`s. (http:// allowed for local dev.)

definition.description:
The workflow document (see WorkflowDocument schema); parsed and
validated before storage.

subject_kind.description:
`"ticket"` or `"board"`; omitted means `"ticket"` (the simple tier's
default). A board-subject document runs against events with no ticket.

trigger_event.description: Domain event type the document is triggered by, e.g. "ticket.created".

CreatedLink.description:
The create response. `token` is the RAW shareable token — shown ONCE,
never stored server-side (only its SHA-256 hash).

booking_path.description: Relative booking path clients render against the public origin.

CreditNote.description:
The credit document. `issued_against_invoice_id` is the issuing
context (may be `None` for a free-standing client credit);
applications may target any issued invoice of the same client and
currency.

applied_minor.description: Sum moved onto invoices, minor units.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code; every amount on the credit uses it.

number.description: Human credit-note number, unique per org (e.g. "CRN-000012").

refunded_minor.description: Sum refunded back out, minor units.

CreditNoteAllocationResponse.description:
Apply/refund response: the credit plus the affected invoice (and the
receipt for applies) so the client reconciles both sides in one shot.

CreditNoteDetail.description: The credit document plus its allocation ledger (GET /{id}).

CreditNoteMutationResponse.description: Instant-first mutation response (IF2) for credit-note mutations.

CreditNoteStatus.description:
Document lifecycle of a credit note. `applied` / `refunded` /
`partially applied` are DERIVED from the counters, never stored —
allocation moves continuously; only a void is a state.

CsatSection.description:
CSAT inputs slot (Wave 34 lane 2): `available` is the honest feature
gate — true only once the org has real survey data, never fabricated
from a zero-window. Scores are 1-5; "low" means score ≤ 2.

avg_score.description: Mean of recorded scores in the window; `None` with no responses.

low_scores.description: Responses at score ≤ 2 in the window — the automation trigger zone.

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

fields.description: Per-field human values; a `null` value un-curates the field.

CustomDomainInstructions.description: Manual DNS setup instructions (the seam's none-mode), ready to render.

CustomDomainView.description:
GET response: current state + verification status + whether a DNS-provider
plugin is installed (A8 (F)).

domain.description: The stored domain, or `null` when none is set.

oneOf.description: Manual paste instructions for the current domain (`null` when none).

provider_plugin_installed.description:
Whether an enabled plugin install in this org holds the
`org_custom_domain.manage` capability — a DNS-provider plugin that can
automate the records. Always informational: the manual path needs none.

verification_token.description: The TXT challenge for the current domain (`null` when none is set).

verified_at.description: When Core last verified the TXT token, or `null`.

manifest_version.description: Envelope schema version. Bump ONLY for breaking section reshapes.

sections.description: The customization sections. Always fully serialized.

DayCapacity.description: One technician's capacity for one day of the horizon.

available_minutes.description: Availability coverage minus exclusions for the UTC day.

booked_minutes.description: Live booking minutes clipped to the day.

free_minutes.description:
What a NEW booking can still consume: availability minus
exclusions minus existing bookings.

required_units.description: Tools count whole units; consumables carry milli-units.

date.description:
The day to assemble; defaults to today (UTC). Callers with a local
timezone pass their own date so the panel agrees with the wall clock.

is_tech_vehicle.description: True when this is the tech's own van/truck: gear already aboard.

reason.description:
`direct_to_site` | `start_point_unknown` when the list shows;
`office_start` / `no_stops` never reach this view.

coverage_warnings.description:
Typed sentences: a ticked quantity that cannot cover the remaining
stops of this trip.

opens_at_office.description:
The trip opens where the tech can re-collect: the office when the day
starts there or a logged office return precedes it.

date.description:
Local date in the TARGET user's timezone. Day view: the day itself.
Week view: any date inside the week (Monday-start). Defaults to
today in that timezone.

user_id.description:
Whose calendar. Defaults to the caller; another user requires
owner/admin.

DealDetail.description: The deal aggregate: document + transition ledger.

DealStatus.description:
A deal's posture, mirroring its stage's kind. Kept as a distinct enum
so consumers filter deals without resolving the stage row.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + If-Match
`version` on the request.

DecideAppointmentRequest.description:
A staff decision body. `decision_note` is the (optional) reason shown
to the client on decline and a confirmation note on approve.

DecideResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2) for a decision. `appointment`
is present ONLY on approve: the calendar booking this decision made.

entity_type.description: `ticket` | `alert` — the REAL org entity to compose from.

fire.description:
When true, one shadow decision run rides the REAL edge
(admission, shadow answer store, ledger, caps, typed quiet).

above_threshold.description: True when this answer cleared the question's own `act` threshold.

label.description: The label the model would have used, in words. Never an index.

DecisionRunSummary.description: The four figures the run log leads with.

above_threshold.description: Runs with at least one answer above its `act` threshold.

agreed.description: Runs whose proposal matches the status the ticket actually reached.

comparable.description: Runs that could be compared at all (a ticket that still exists).

has_evidence.description:
False when the product has never recorded a run for this surface, so
the page can say "no evidence yet" rather than showing zeros.

lowest_threshold.description:
The loosest `act` threshold in force. A surface that mixes question
kinds has one line PER QUESTION (ADR 0010 §5), so the pair is the
honest headline: a surface whose questions share one line reports both
as the same number.

threshold.description:
The strictest `act` threshold in force, so the log and the drawer
agree on the number that gates the most.

threshold_questions.description:
How many questions carry a line, so the figure is never read as "the"
line when there are several.

DecisionRunView.description: One answered run, in the words the run log draws.

above_threshold.description: True when any answer cleared the surface's `act` threshold.

agreed.description:
True when a picked label matches the status the ticket actually
reached. False when the run disagreed, None when the ticket moved on
before its status could be compared.

answers.description:
What it would have said: the picked label per question, with the
confidence that decided it.

current_status.description:
The status the ticket sits in now — the human's answer, and the only
thing agreement can be measured against.

ticket_id.description: The ticket the run was about, when it was about one.

top_confidence.description: The highest confidence in the run, for the log's meter.

configured.description:
False while the org never configured the surface — the ADR 0011
§3 posture: silently quiet, shown with its what-activates note.

internal.description:
Internal decision surfaces (search_rerank / llm_verify /
tool_routing / loop_termination) are never grant targets; the UI
renders their posture note-only.

latest_starter_version.description: None while no curated set exists for the surface version.

DeclarationView.description:
Wire shape of one declaration. Kinds/options are flattened so generated
clients can render editors directly from this payload.

options.description: Closed option set for enumerations; empty otherwise.

section.description: Settings-hub section this declaration renders under.

visibility.description: "ui" renders an editable row; "hidden" is state readable via values.

DedupeEntityKind.description:
The entity family a dedupe record binds. Clients ride reconciliation
only (mapping decisions, not folds).

DedupeRunMode.description: What an automated pass DOES with its above-threshold suggestions.

confidence.description: The recorded answer's probability/noul number, when one came back.

label.description: Human label pair ("A" ← "B") for the report body.

DedupeRunReport.description:
One pass's outcome — the run report (persisted on the workflow row and
delivered to the designated users as a `dedupe_report` notification).

above_threshold.description: Suggestions whose answer sat at/above the workflow threshold.

outcomes.description: Per-candidate outcomes for the report/notification body.

truncated.description:
The asks the pass would have fired next run (the resource-efficiency
cap applies per run; a truncated pass is VISIBLE, never silent).

dry_run.description:
Preview posture: fire the asks (suggestion-grade, recorded) but
stamp nothing, merge nothing, notify no one.

DedupeWorkflow.description: One org's Jev dedupe workflow (the `dedupe_workflows` row).

confidence_threshold.description:
The workflow's own confidence dial: auto_merge folds only at/above
this; everything below stays queued for the workbench.

interval_hours.description: Scheduled cadence; None = manual runs only (the workbench trigger).
Scheduled cadence in hours (None = manual runs only).

decision_configured.description:
The gate's honest state: whether the org's decision model is
configured right now (the workflow can be stored even when the
model later goes down — the RUN then degrades quiet, per ADR 0010).

DeeplinkEntry.description: One resolved one-click link on a PO, in open order.

DefinitionScope.description:
Visibility scope of a stored definition: `org` (published org-wide,
admins only) or `self` (private to the creator).

DeleteStatusResult.description:
What a delete with reassignment actually did (Wave 41 lane 12).

Returned instead of a bare 204 because the confirm has to say what
happened, and the admin is the one who has to believe it.

moved_tickets.description: Tickets moved to the replacement status before the delete.

paused_automations.description:
Automation rules that named this status and were PAUSED. Never
repointed: an automation's conditions are the org's own logic.

sla_pauses_changed.description: SLA pause states opened or closed by the move.

response_status.description: HTTP status when a response arrived; null for transport failures.

counts.description:
Complete status set — zero counts included, so the summary strip
never hides a state by omission.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; `None` = exhausted.

transport_configured.description: False when no transport is configured: every row then sits queued.

oneOf.description:
Which rung of the greeting/signature chain supplied each block for
THIS message (Wave 42), as the wire name plus the wording an admin
reads. `None` is a row written before the lane recorded it, and it
renders as "none" rather than a guess.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page; absent when exhausted.

DependencyListResponse.description:
A task's direct finish-to-start dependencies (full rows, so the client
renders "blocked by" without extra fetches).

attachments.description:
Files that rode the message; the v1 scanner returns one verdict per
message (body plus attachment bytes), so these are what was scanned
with it, not per-file verdicts.

ingest_source.description: Ledger transport label — the ingest source (`webhook/clamd`, …).

verdict.description:
Recorded scan verdict (`infected`); fail-closed quarantines ride the
same status, so the pane words it as "quarantined", not "virus".

client_id.description:
NULL for internal-org assets; the DB CHECK (migration 0103) ties
`scope` and `client_id` together structurally.

curated_fields.description: CI5: human-set tier; sticky forever, never auto-overwritten.

field_sources.description: CI5: per observed field `{source_system, source_link_id, observed_at}`.

fields.description:
Custom-field values validated against the layout's schema
(docs-platform v1 shape; app-validated). The EFFECTIVE view:
curated wins over observed (CI5, migration 0061).

identity_keys.description: CI3 deterministic identity keys (source GUID, serial, MACs, ...).

kind.description:
Free-text connector compatibility column; typed classification
lives in `layout_id` + `fields` (asset taxonomy, migration 0054).

layout_id.description: The typed layout this asset instantiates; NULL = untyped.

merged_into_id.description: CI4: non-NULL means this row was absorbed by the target (tombstone).

observed_fields.description: CI5: feed-written tier; churns silently with its source.

purchase_fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: inventory receipt) —
locked once when the purchase cost is written in a non-base
currency; immutable afterwards (DB trigger enforced).

scope.description:
client | internal_org (migration 0103): the MSP's OWN equipment
rides the SAME DeviceAsset lifecycle under an org-scoped row —
client_id NULL, never a fake client record.

oneOf.description:
The warranty horizon, derived from this row's own columns through
`asset_warranty_from_fields` at read time. It travels WITH the asset so
no surface has to re-derive it from `purchase_date` plus
`useful_life_months` — that duplication is how a ledger and a scan
sheet end up disagreeing about which side of the window an asset sits
on. NULL when the asset carries nothing to derive a horizon from.

DispatchAppointment.description:
One booking block on the dispatch board: the appointment plus the
ticket number and client name the block face renders.

oneOf.description:
Latest field-service status push against this booking (dispatch v2,
additive): `None` when nothing was pushed yet.

Travel provenance (Wave 32 lane 7): where the estimate ran from,
which provider produced it, and at what quality. All absent for
manual or unestimated bookings.

DispatchDayQuery.description:
One dispatch-path query: `date` is a LOCAL date interpreted as the
UTC day window (documented UTC scope).

date.description: The day to assemble; defaults to today (UTC).

DispatchDayView.description: The assembled day-view payload: one request, one render.

unassigned.description:
Unassigned, non-closed tickets in dispatch order (priority rank,
then effective SLA/due deadline).

DispatchStatusShade.description:
The latest connector/staff status push for one booking, shaded onto
the board block face.

DnsRecordInstruction.description:
One DNS record an operator pastes by hand. Mirrors the solver's
`ManualDnsRecord` as a utoipa schema (the seam crate carries no OpenAPI
dependency).

Document.description:
A document's living handle. No content lives here — content is only
ever a [`DocumentVersion`]; `current_version` names the newest one.

client_id.description:
NULL = org-global document; set = client-scoped (docs-platform v1,
migration 0053).

current_version.description: The newest version number in the document's history.

fields.description: Custom-field values validated against the layout's schema.

layout_id.description: The typed layout this document instantiates; NULL = untyped.

object_removed.description: Whether the backing object was reclaimed too (refcount hit 0).

sha256.description: sha256 hex — integrity verifiable after download.

DocumentLayout.description:
An org-managed document/asset type. System layouts (the seeded
standard MSP set) are editable but not deletable.

oneOf.description:
CI6: the behavior-bearing semantic class this type is bound to
(ADR 0003, migration 0061). Renaming the layout never changes
behavior; identity keys and field schema read this class.

client_id.description:
Scope narrow: a client uuid, or the literal `global` for org-wide
documents (docs-platform v1). Absent = all scopes.

q.description: Title substring narrowing; ranked full-text search rides /api/search.

DocumentMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): document fields at the top
level plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

DocumentVersion.description:
One immutable snapshot in a document's append-only history. Every
version stores its complete title + body, so any pair is diffable
without reconstructing intermediate state.

change_summary.description: Optional human explanation of what changed in this version.

restored_from_version.description:
Set when this version was created by a RESTORE: the historical
version whose content was copied. Restore-creates-new-version is
the only way old content comes back — history is never rewritten.

DocumentView.description:
GET /api/documents/{id} response: the living handle plus the CURRENT
version's content (read-your-write on the body the last write stored).

label.description: Free-form run label recorded with the dry-run history entry.

template_id.description:
Optional saved field-mapping template: source headers are renamed to
the template's canonical columns before validation (D2 remainder).

DryRunRequest.description:
POST /api/imports/dry-run request: validate a full payload and report
what each row WOULD do before any data write. The probe is recorded as a
finished dry-run batch for operator history.

DunningState.description:
Collections posture of an issued invoice. Forward-only: states are
data moved by explicit API writes (events + write trail), never a
background side effect.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key +
If-Match `version` on the invoice.

to_state.description:
The target state; must be strictly forward on the ladder
(skipping rungs is allowed).

error.description: Set when the address lookup failed.

resolves.description:
Whether the domain resolves to at least one address. Plausibility
only: an edge-proxied record resolves to the CDN's IPs.

oneOf.description:
Org MFA policy satisfied the same way as password login: any
enrolled factor must complete via POST /api/auth/mfa/verify.

name.description: URL path segment used by the exchange + link routes.

actions.description: AutomationAction documents, parsed and validated via core-domain.

board_id.description: The board a ticket-less subject is scoped to.

ticket_id.description:
The ticket the subject resolved to. `None` on a board-subject match
(Wave 43 lane 3) — there is no ticket to act on.

EmailDeliveryView.description:
Delivery projection from the `email_outbound` ledger. Present for
outbound rows only — inbound mail has no send lifecycle.

EmailDirection.description: Whether a message entered (inbound) or left (outbound) the system.

EmailEnvelopeOverride.description:
The greeting and signature a composer wrote for THIS message (Wave 42).

Purely additive and purely per-message: it changes what goes out with
this one note and is never stored as a preference. The composer
prefills both fields from the sender's own default, so this carries the
