(`migration_cursor_mismatch`) — chunks are sequential.

replay.description:
`true` when an exact re-send replayed the stored report without
touching data (retry after a lost response is free).

rows_total.description: Cumulative batch counters after this chunk.

PushChunkSummary.description:
u32-friendly mirror of the per-chunk summary so the generated SDK gets
plain integers without overflow caveats (same shape as D2's
`ChunkSummaryWire`, but also deserialize for replay).

PushSessionCreated.description: 201 body: the session id, its D2 batch, and the starting cursor.

PushSessionFinishedResponse.description:
POST /api/migration/push/sessions/{id}/finish — closes the session and
its D2 batch; returns the cumulative run totals.

PushSessionView.description:
GET /api/migration/push/sessions/{id} — the resume view a tool asks
after a crash: where the checkpoint stands and which chunks committed.

PushStatusMutationResponse.description: 201 body: the pushed row plus the read-your-write metadata (IF2).

occurred_at.description: When the status was observed; defaults to now (server clock).

status.description:
Field-service status: en_route | arrived | in_progress | completed
| blocked | delayed.

PushStatusResponse.description: The pushed row (entity fields; the mutation envelope flattens it).

capabilities.description:
OMITTED (vs explicit empty) keeps the existing row's tags — a
re-seal without a capabilities payload must not silently wipe the
capability enforcement data (Wave 18 lane 2b, item 4).

secret.description: Plaintext secret — sealed at rest, never surfaced back.

key.description:
The org-unique plugin surface key (lowercase snake). Re-PUT with
the same key UPDATES the registration and re-enables it.

from_address.description:
All fields optional and partial: only present keys are written; an
explicit `null` (or blank string) clears that field back to the org
identity.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

api_key.description: Plaintext API key / token to be sealed at rest.

provider.description:
Provider name: an AI provider ("openai", "anthropic", "ollama",
"custom") or an export-sync connector ("qbo", "xero").

PutByokSecretRequest.description: Request to store or update a sealed BYOK API key.

items.description: The complete required-step list; replaces any previous items.

require_checklist_close.description: Enforcement toggle (defaults-first: OFF until explicitly enabled).

config.description:
Full `SurfaceConfig` JSON (state_template + questions +
thresholds). Threshold editors ride this.

mode.description: `shadow` (record only) | `live`. Shadow is the landing posture.

model_provider.description:
Pinned decision model (e.g. `typesafe` / `jev-1.13.0`, never a
floating tag — answer provenance records exactly this id).

reset_to_starter.description: Discard the fork; re-reference the LATEST curated starter set.

visible_status_ids.description:
Empty = all statuses visible (v1 default). Non-empty narrows to
statuses OF THAT BOARD — unknown ids are rejected, not silently kept.

enabled.description: Enables/disables catch-all routing; absent keeps the stored value.

instant.description:
Autosave claim key (IF1): same key on a debounced retry is a no-op
overwrite (last-writer-wins per §5.2 cadence).

ses_endpoint.description: Optional SES endpoint override, for a VPC interface endpoint.

ses_region.description: AWS region whose SES endpoint this org sends through (transport=ses).

signature_policy.description:
`allowed` | `org_locked` (Wave 42). Absent leaves the policy alone,
so an older client that does not know the key cannot reset it.

state.description:
"set" (value replaces the org default) or "disabled" (explicit deny
that wins over an org-enabled default).

value.description:
The typed payload (uuid string for reference kinds, boolean for
toggles); MUST be absent for "disabled".

PutOverrideRequest.description:
PUT body: `{ "state": "set", "value": <typed payload> }` or
`{ "state": "disabled" }`, plus the instant-first parameters.

config.description:
The full matrix; the store is whole-document (admins edit the
matrix in one pass). Must satisfy [`validate_matrix`].

artifact_digest.description: sha256 hex of the artifact release the rating pins.

postmark_server_token.description: Postmark server token (required when transport = postmark).

ses_access_key_id.description: SES IAM access key id (required when transport = ses).

ses_secret_access_key.description:
SES IAM secret access key (required when transport = ses). The
secret half of the pair — required alongside the id, never instead
of it, because a lone key id cannot sign a request.

transport.description: `postmark`, `smtp` or `ses` — which credential this request rotates.

QueueMutationResponse.description:
Queue mutation envelope (set + clear share the shape; clears carry
`cleared: true` and null note).

decided_by.description: Per-approver decision history: entries this approver decided.

status.description: Filter by approval state; defaults to `submitted` (the queue).

rank_override.description:
The dispatcher-set rank pinning this ticket's position (overrides
sort ahead of the computed order); absent = computed order only.

QueuedTicket.description:
One queued ticket: the day-view's queue row shape plus the explicit
override when one exists.

QuotaMetricView.description:
A single metric's reading: the measured usage, the configured limit
(when one exists), and the percentage of the limit in use.

limit.description: The configured limit, or `None` when the org configured none.

percent.description:
`usage` as a percentage of `limit`, to one decimal. `None` whenever
there is no limit to measure against (or the limit is zero), never
an error and never clamped: 300.0 is a valid, reportable reading.

setting_key.description: The org-settings key the limit is read from.

usage.description:
The measured value, or `None` when the org's usage row has never
been refreshed — an unmeasured org is not a zero org.

Quote.description:
The quote document. `subtotal/tax/total` are persisted roll-ups of the
lines, recomputed on every draft edit.

converted_contract_id.description:
The contract the convert-to-invoice seam materialized (NULL until
converted).

converted_invoice_id.description: The DRAFT invoice the seam created (NULL until converted).

decided_at.description: When the quote reached a terminal accept/decline/expire state.

number.description: Human quote number, unique per org (e.g. "Q-000012").

valid_until.description: Last day the quote is valid; conversion after this is refused.

QuoteLifecycleRequest.description:
A lifecycle leg body (send/accept/decline/expire): envelope params
only; the target status is the URL.

QuoteLine.description:
One quote line. `amount_minor` is the half-even product of
`quantity_milli × unit_amount_minor / 1000`; the API recomputes it.

quantity_milli.description: Quantity in thousandths of a unit (1.5 = 1500).

QuoteLineInput.description:
One requested line. Catalog-backed lines snapshot the item's
description/unit/price/taxability at write time; free lines name
their own.

description.description: Required when no catalog item backs the line.

quantity_milli.description: Quantity in thousandths of a unit (1.5 = 1500).

unit.description: Defaults to the catalog item's unit or `each`.

unit_amount_minor.description:
Per-unit price, minor units; required when no catalog item backs
the line.

QuoteMutationResponse.description: Instant-first mutation response (IF2) for quote mutations.

QuoteStatus.description: Lifecycle of a quote. `accepted` / `declined` / `expired` are terminal.

RagChunkInput.description: Input chunk in a batch ingest request before provider embedding resolution.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based passage or frame/segment index within the source.

content_hash.description:
Content hash for idempotent re-ingest provenance. Computed
deterministically as SHA-256 hex when omitted.

content_text.description:
Passage text (required when `modality == text` and `embedding` is
omitted; optional caption/transcript snippet for media chunks to
participate in the lexical BM25 leg).

embedding.description:
Precomputed 768-dim vector. Required for `image | video | audio`
modalities; optional for `text` chunks when the org has an active
embedding provider.

metadata.description:
Attribution metadata (title, uri/locator, span/page/timecode,
mime_type, etc.) returned on every query hit. Defaults to `{}`.

modality.description: Modality of this chunk (`text | image | video | audio`).

source_id.description:
Stable identifier of the source within `source_kind` (UUID or external
locator).

source_kind.description:
Source entity family (e.g. `"ticket"`, `"kb_article"`, `"attachment"`,
`"document"`, or a connector-defined kind).

RagChunkKey.description:
Composite chunk identity within an org + namespace:
`(source_kind, source_id, chunk_index, modality)`.

RagDeleteSourceResponse.description: Response from deleting a source's chunks in a namespace.

RagDeletionReceipt.description:
Provable deletion receipt recorded when a source's chunks are removed from
`rag_embeddings` (ADR 0020 §6).

namespace.description:
Logical vector namespace within the tenant (e.g. `"default"`,
`"kb-passages"`, `"ticket-media"`). Queries never cross namespaces.

RagModality.description: First-class modality of a stored chunk or query filter (ADR 0020 §3).

RagQueryHit.description: Ranked RAG hit with mandatory source attribution (ADR 0020 §4).

lexical_score.description:
Lexical FTS rank (`ts_rank_cd`) when the BM25/FTS leg ran and matched
this chunk.

score.description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion score combining the active retrieval legs.

vector_distance.description:
Cosine distance (`embedding <=> $query_vec`) when the vector leg ran
and matched this chunk.

RagQueryRequest.description: Hybrid BM25 + exact-KNN query request for `POST /api/v1/rag/query`.

modalities.description:
Optional modality filter (`text | image | video | audio`). When empty
or omitted, all modalities in the namespace participate (cross-modal
retrieval).

namespace.description:
Target namespace within the caller's org. Queries never cross
namespaces.

query_text.description:
Optional lexical query string. When supplied without `query_vector`,
Core also embeds `query_text` via the org's configured embedding
provider so both the BM25 and vector legs run and fuse via RRF.

query_vector.description:
Optional precomputed 768-dim query vector. Enables media->text,
media->media, and caller-embedded text->media queries across the shared
768-dimension space.

lexical_leg_active.description: Whether the lexical BM25/FTS leg participated in this query.

vector_leg_active.description: Whether the 768-dim exact-KNN vector leg participated in this query.

RateSpec.description: T&M rate-card row spec (hourly minor units per `work_type`).

summary.description:
Aggregate for the requested target (or the whole org list when
unfiltered — the aggregate then spans targets and is advisory).

count.description: Aggregated over the org: count of ratings and the mean.

oneOf.description: The caller's own rating on this target, when one exists.

ReadGuardrails.description:
The guardrails a declared read runs under (ADR 0017 §5).

Three of the four are ceilings a declaration may not exceed; the fourth
is a promise that may only be declared one way. Validation applies the
platform floors here so a manifest cannot write itself a weaker cap.

max_calls_per_run.description:
Calls this node may make in ONE workflow run. The per-run cap is
what stops a loop over a device list becoming a hammer.

max_output_bytes.description: Hard ceiling on the returned payload's size.

may_return_secrets.description:
Must be `false`, and validation refuses anything else. A read node
may never return a vault secret, because the run ledger is a place
operators read.

min_interval_secs.description:
Minimum seconds between this ORG's read-node invocations. The
per-org cap is what stops a schedule becoming a stream.

serial_numbers.description:
Serialized stock items only: one serial per unit (qty_milli must be
`count × 1000`). Each serial posts its own ledger row + receipt line.

allow_over_receipt.description:
Explicit acknowledgement for an over-receipt; absent/false refuses
with a typed 409.

location_id.description: Where the goods landed (lane-1 stock location).

qty_milli.description: MILLI of the item's unit; serialized items move 1000/serial.

serial_numbers.description: Serialized receives carry one entry per physical unit.

ticket_id.description:
Optional ticket anchor. A return/restock of parts from a job carries
the ticket so the movement lands on that ticket's timeline instead of
forcing a detour through the stock surfaces (Wave 32 lane 6).

unit_cost_minor.description:
Unit cost in the item's cost currency (locked at receipt on the
ledger row; ADR 0002 inventory-receipt lock moment).

ReceiveRequest.description:
POST /api/stock/{receive|consume|adjust|transfer|ship-out} bodies.
All quantities are `milli` thousandths of the item's unit (parity with
quote lines); signed legs are normalized per kind below.

to.description: Exclusive window end (default: now). Capped at 366 days.

expense_minor.description: Linked expenses total in the org's base currency.

reimbursement_minor.description: Mileage reimbursement owed to the technician at the org rate.

amount_minor.description: Absent → the received total from the PO lines.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key +
If-Match `version` on the invoice.

amount_minor.description:
Amount to collect, minor units; must not exceed the outstanding
balance. Currency is always the invoice's own.

base_currency.description: 1 base major unit buys `rate` quote major units.

recovery_codes.description: Plaintext codes — displayed once, stored only as argon2id hashes.

RefineNoteResponse.description:
Refine outcome. `proposal` is a SUGGESTION — applying it is an explicit
user action that posts through the normal comment-create envelope with
`workflow_meta.kind = "refined"`; AI provenance rides the approval
pipeline (docs/10-agent-platform.md), never a direct ledger write.

refresh_token.description:
Optional: when omitted, the refresh pair rides the httpOnly
session cookie (browser clients); bearer-mode clients keep
sending both fields exactly as before.

amount_minor.description:
Refund amount, minor units; must not exceed the credit's
remaining value.

org_name.description: Organization name — becomes the tenant for this deployment.

ticket_prefix.description: Ticket number prefix, e.g. "MAR" → MAR-2841. Defaults to "MAR".

ReleaseStatus.description:
Release lifecycle: `pending` (released, not yet invoiced), `billed`
(carried on an invoice line), `cancelled` (terminal — an admin
correction; the same milestone may re-release afterwards).

entity_id.description:
The entity the template's purpose points at (stock item id, serial
id, location id, or device asset id).

context_id.description: The ticket the variables resolve from.

The entity the variables resolve from: a ticket id for
ticket/note/email/workflow kinds, a project id for `project`, a
quote id for `quote_invoice`. `null` (or omitted) for `kb`.

ordered_ids.description: Category ids in their new display order.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.

parent_id.description: New root category (must be a root of this org).

skills.description: Full replacement set (an empty set clears every requirement).
Full replacement set (an empty set clears every skill).

enabled.description: Inbound routing is what makes client replies land on tickets.

ReplySnippetMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the snippet at the top level
plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

ReplySnippetView.description: One canned reply in the org's snippet library.

board_ids.description: Boards the snippet is offered on. Empty = every board.

forked_from.description:
Fork-on-edit provenance: the origin snippet this copy was forked
from, when it is a fork.

vocabulary.description: The closed variable vocabulary snippets may use (ticket context).

ReportDefinitionMutationResponse.description:
Mutation envelope: applied definition (flattened) + read-your-write
metadata (IF2).

ReportDefinitionRunQuery.description:
Query surface for running a stored definition (mirrors the prebuilt
kinds' loose GET shape; irrelevant fields ignored).

format.description: `"csv"` streams text/csv instead of the JSON envelope.

from.description: Inclusive window start (UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 trailing days.

to.description: Inclusive window end (UTC day). Max span with `from`: 366 days.

ReportDefinitionView.description:
A stored report definition with its registry-validated spec
reassembled (`spec.view` == the stored `kind` column).

ReportDeliveryPage.description:
GET /api/report-schedules/{id}/deliveries envelope — offset-paged
delivery history, newest slot first.

total.description: Total ledger rows for the schedule (org-scoped).

ReportDeliveryView.description:
One delivery-history row (R4): the claimed slot, the outcome status
(`delivered|partial|failed|skipped`), the per-recipient outcome
detail, and when the ledger row landed.

detail.description:
Per-recipient outcome counters
(`{"delivered": n, "disabled": n, "quiet_deferred": n, "failed": [..]}`).

slot_at.description: The claimed slot this run discharged.

ReportPage.description: JSON envelope for a report page.

columns.description:
Stable column order (JSON objects here preserve insertion order via
serde_json preserve_order feature transparently at runtime).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor`; absent when exhausted or unpaged.

view.description: Versioned read-model view backing this kind (documentation parity).

ReportScheduleMutationResponse.description: Mutation envelope: applied schedule + read-your-write metadata (IF2).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor`; absent when exhausted.

ReportScheduleView.description:
One delivery schedule with its next-run preview (the materialized
`next_run_at` the worker claims against) and definition coordinates.

next_run_at.description: Next-run preview — the instant the worker will next claim.

ReportSpec.description:
A stored report spec (TASKLIST R3). Every member is registry-validated;
see [`ReportSpec::validate`].

group_by.description:
Group-by dimensions (any projected column except `org_id`). Empty
means a single grand-total row.

view.description:
The versioned read-model view this report reads (the stored `kind`
column). NEVER a physical table — the enum has no other variants.

viz.description: Presentation hint (never affects the compiled SQL).

oneOf.description: A concrete effective value is in force.

fetch.description:
Fetch the provider's oEmbed HTML now (server-side, https, 10s
budget). Default false: registry-only resolution.

url.description: The embed URL to validate against the allowlist.

Render-ready details of a resolved reference value: names and the semantic
category travel WITH the resolution so consumers never branch on labels and
never need a second lookup.

category.description: The semantic category the behavior layer keys on.

dropped_lines.description: Lines dropped because they could not fit at the minimum line height.

target_deleted.description:
The target's own current link count — surfaced for document
targets so the panel can hint at hub records.

target_label.description: Present when the target row still exists.

ResolvedLink.description:
A link with its target resolved to a display label for the UI
(typed read model; the raw row never carries the label).

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

version.description: The historical version whose content the NEW version copies.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.

mode.description:
How far back the re-run goes. `resume` (the default) starts at the
first step that did not succeed, so the steps before it are not run
again. `from_start` re-runs the whole document and is only allowed
when every step that already succeeded is safe to repeat.

lines.description: Lines to return; empty/absent = every outstanding device.

to_location_id.description: Required when any returned device came from stock.

fields.description: Record fields whose values were restored.

reverted_seq.description: The write-trail seq the revert stepped back over.

whole_record.description: Whether this was a whole-record step (no explicit field list).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version, exactly as any autosave write.

fields.description:
Explicit per-field revert: restore ONLY these fields to their values
at the target write. Omit for a whole-record step (rejected with
`undo_reverts_only` while the record is closed).

seq.description: The write-trail `seq` to step back over (from the undo stack).

reason.description: Why the sign-off no longer stands. Part of the audit record.

RoleMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the role at the top level plus
the additive `mutation` metadata.

RoleView.description:
One org role row (preset or custom). `permissions` is the raw matrix
vocabulary: `{"matrix": {"module", "action"}}` entries plus bare
special strings (`"financial:read"`, `"special:manage_users"`, …).

builtin.description: Shipped preset tag (owner, admin, …), `null` for org-created roles.

forked_from.description: For a forked copy: the preset tag it was seeded from.

is_system.description: Preset rows are system data: restorable, never editable in place.

portal_tiers.description: The portal tiers (client contacts; a separate authorization model).

presets.description: The canonical shipped presets (the restore source of truth).

roles.description: Every org role: presets (system rows) + org-created custom roles.

date.description: The day to assemble; defaults to today (UTC), matching the board.

RoutingProfile.description:
The routing-capability declaration a provider pack carries. Closed
vocabularies only; a pack cannot declare a capability or mode the seam
does not speak.

base_url.description: The pack's contract root: https-only absolute URL, no credentials.

contract_revision.description: Contract revision the pack implements; the core speaks revision 1.

quality.description:
`measured` | `heuristic` — relay packs are measured; a heuristic
pack is allowed but never unlocks suggestion-grade features.

time_control.description:
`none` | `departure` | `arrival` | `both` — which time control the
pack honors. Anything it does not honor must not be claimed.

RoutingProviderStatus.description:
Serialized provider posture (mirrors `core_routing::RoutingStatusView`
with a schema-friendly shape).

RowFormat.description: Wire format selector for an import payload.

oneOf.description: Validated clean and unmapped — committing would INSERT.
Mapped, differs, update policy — committing would UPDATE.
Nothing would happen; the reason distinguishes identical-vs-policy.

Validation failed or a fail-policy conflict fired; `errors` carries
human-readable items for operators.

RowReport.description:
Per-row dry-run/commit report entry. The wire shape contract from D2:
every row maps to exactly one of `errors[]`, `ok`, `would_skip`,
`would_update`.

RowsPayload.description: The encoded row source shared by dry-run and chunk posts.

csv.description:
Full CSV text including header row (`format=csv`). UTF-8, BOM
tolerated; RFC 4180 quoting supported.

json_rows.description:
Row objects as a JSON array of flat objects (`format=json`). Nulls
behave exactly like absent keys.

RunBatchResponse.description:
POST /imports/batches/{id}/run response: the batch is queued for the
worker exactly once; poll the batch view for counters.

steps.description: The whole trace in execution order.

RunDetailView.description:
A run plus the exact document it ran and the state it continues from.
This is the response that makes the ledger an audit record: with it, a
run explains itself without a second table.

RunListQuery.description: Query for the run ledger listing.

rule_id.description: Optional rule filter: only that workflow's runs.

status.description: Optional status filter: running | waiting | succeeded | failed | abandoned.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; `null` on the last one.

RunReportResponse.description:
Per-row fate report — the D2 contract shape
(`row_index → errors[] | ok | would_skip | would_update`).

RunRetryResponse.description:
The retry's response: the NEW run row (the continuation of the failed
one) and the IF2 mutation metadata, on the same envelope every other
mutation in the product answers with.

RunSpecRequest.description:
POST /api/reports/run-spec body: an inline spec (validated through the
same registry as stored definitions) plus the run window. This is the
builder's PREVIEW-before-save surface — nothing is persisted.

from.description: Inclusive window start (UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 trailing days.

to.description: Inclusive window end (UTC day). Max span with `from`: 366 days.

RunStepListQuery.description: Query for one run's step trace.

RunStepView.description: One step attempt inside a run.

RunView.description:
A run as the operator surface reads it. The document snapshot is NOT
here: it is large, it is write-once, and the operator does not need it to
read a status. It is on the detail response, where an operator who wants
to know exactly what ran can find it.

resumed_from.description:
The parked run this row continues. A row is an EXECUTION ATTEMPT;
a resume is a new row, never an edit of the parked one.

retried.description: Derived, never stored: a later run re-runs this one.

retry_of.description: The failed run this row re-runs.

superseded.description:
Derived, never stored: a later run continues this one. Storing the
flag would be a mutation of the parked row wearing a different name.

RunWindowView.description: One issued run window in the overlap warning.

ScanCandidateView.description: One candidate when a code matches more than one row of the same kind.

ScanResolutionView.description:
The typed meaning of one scanned string. `entity_id` is the resolved
entity: the stock item, the serialized unit, the location, or the device
asset. `deep_link` is always the canonical link for that entity, so a
caller can print/re-show exactly what it scanned.

candidates.description: Populated when the winning kind matched more than one row.

client_name.description:
Device assets only: the client the asset belongs to. NULL for an
internal-org asset — the MSP's own fleet carries no client (ADR 0012).

is_tool.description: Serialized units only: the unit is a tool (`is_tool` on its item).

location_name.description: Device assets only: the site the asset sits at.

serial_status.description: Serialized units only: in_stock | out | checked_out | loaned.

stock_item_id.description: Present for stock_item and serialized_unit: the parent item.

oneOf.description:
Device assets only: the warranty horizon, when the asset carries
enough to derive one. Resolution is one read BECAUSE these ride
along: a found sheet prints the pack's three facts without a second
round trip.

text.description:
The raw scanned text (keyboard-wedge burst, camera decode, or a
pasted deep link).

ScanStatus.description:
Outcome of the malware scan that runs between webhook receipt and
persistence. `skipped` is the documented "none" mode (no scanner
configured) — never a silent pass of an actual verdict.

clamd_addr.description: Configured clamd TCP address — a host:port, never a credential.

ScheduleCadence.description:
Wire cadence of a schedule (snake_case slugs matching the stored
column and the worker's parser).

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous page's `next_cursor`.

SchedulingGroup.description:
A free-form admin-defined group/department — a pure availability
pool ("Service Desk"). Deliberately NOT the org chart: no reporting
lines, no permissions; membership only feeds unioned availability.

SchedulingLink.description:
A shareable booking link. The raw token is generated at create,
returned ONCE in the create response, and never stored (only its
SHA-256 hash); the tech's visible lifecycle is the view/schedule/
revoke timestamps.

ticket_id.description: Ticket cross-ref: bookings land back on the originating ticket.

SchedulingLinkBooking.description: The link → booking trail row (mirrors the appointment for audit).

SchedulingLinkStatus.description:
Link lifecycle: `active` → `used` (a booking landed) or `revoked`
(tech pulled it). Expiry is DERIVED (`expires_at` + the template's
booking window), never a stored state.

Scorecard.description: One staff member's scorecard over a window.

ScorecardLatency.description:
First-staff-response latency block (seconds; staff-authored comments
only — portal replies are structurally excluded by the view).

ScorecardSla.description:
SLA attainment block. `response_total`/`resolution_total` count only
tickets where BOTH the SLA target and the actual instant exist (the
three-valued metrics from `ops.v1_sla_outcomes`); attainment is the
met/total ratio, `None` when the total is zero.

to.description: Exclusive end (UTC midnight of the day after `to`).

ScorecardWorkload.description:
Workload mix over APPROVED time entries only — drafts and rejected
entries are never scorecard truth (Wave 14 lane-1 approval contract).

billable_ratio.description: billable / total approved minutes; `None` with no approved work.

by_work_type.description:
APPROVED minutes per work type; `work_type: null` groups
unclassified entries.

SearchPinView.description: One pinned result as the /search surface renders it.

parent_id.description: e.g. comment → its ticket id; mirrors the live row.

query.description: The pinned query, snapshotted (a pin re-runs THIS query).

title.description: The title AT PIN TIME (the honest snapshot, never re-faked).

client_id.description:
Optional client scope for the `document` kind (0089, per-client
document scoping): when set, indexed documents answer only when
org-global (client_scope NULL) or scoped to THIS client. Every
other kind is untouched.

q.description:
Free-text query using websearch syntax: `"exact phrases"`,
`-excluded`, plain terms AND-ed. Tokens ≥3 chars also match as
substrings via the trigram fallback.

kinds.description: Kinds the principal may see, mirrored into the query filter.

total.description: Total matches across all permitted kinds.

parent_id.description: comment → its ticket id; NULL otherwise.

score.description: Blended FTS + trigram relevance score (higher is better).

snippet.description: Raw body excerpt for client-side snippet rendering.

SecretCategoryGrant.description:
A role × folder category grant (`secret_category_grants`). Grants are
DATA flowing through the central policy module: the matrix permission
(`secrets:read`/`secrets:edit`) is checked FIRST, then the category
gate — restricted folders deny unless a grant row for one of the
caller's roles allows it.

SecretFieldMeta.description:
A material field of a secret record — METADATA ONLY view. The
ciphertext and plaintext never ride this entity; `value_ciphertext`
lives in `secret_fields` only.

field_key.description:
Closed write-path vocabulary: `secret`, `notes`, `username`, `url`,
plus the document-field keys (metadata for non-material pointers).

has_value.description: Whether a sealed value exists for this key.

value.description:
Plaintext on the WIRE ONLY: sealed before any persistence, never
returned outside the audited reveal response.
None (json null) clears the sealed field; Some rotates it.

SecretFolder.description:
A secret category folder (`secret_folders`). Exactly one of org/client
scope rows: org-scope rows carry `org_id` (client_id NULL),
client-scope rows carry `client_id` (org_id NULL — the tenancy spine
rides the owning client's org via the RLS policy). Seeded defaults
(`is_default_seed`) are immutable ADR-0004 template rows: orgs fork,
never edit in place. `restricted` is deny-by-default: invisible to a
role without a `secret_category_grants` row.

client_id.description: Client scope; NULL on org-scope rows.

forked_from.description: The seed row this folder forked from (customization provenance).

org_id.description: Org-scope tenancy root; NULL on client-scope rows.

parent_id.description: Parent folder; NULL = root of its scope tree.

SecretFolderKind.description: The closed seeded-configuration vocabulary for folders.

SecretRecord.description:
A SecretRecord (`secret_records`, migration 0078) — the generalization
beside the shipped `PasswordEntry` (whose UI and responses stay byte-
compatible; the vault never becomes a destructive cutover). Scope
mirrors its owning folder; every material field is sealed in
`secret_fields` and reachable ONLY via the audited reveal path.

client_id.description: Client scope; NULL on org-scope rows.

fields.description: Metadata-only field views (NEVER carries ciphertext or plaintext).

last_rotated_at.description: Stamped by the same update that moves `rotate_at` forward.

object_key.description:
Document-kind files ride object storage as ciphertext with
pointer+hash rows — never material blobs in this table.

org_id.description: Org-scope tenancy root; NULL on client-scope rows.

rotate_at.description:
Operator-scheduled rotation due date (Wave 19 lane 3) — additive
on 0078's record shape; the worker sweep reminds once past it.

SecretRecordMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the metadata-only record plus
the write-trail/replay metadata (mirrors PasswordMutationResponse).

SecretReveal.description:
The audited reveal response: the ONLY plaintext carrier for secret
records, mirroring `/passwords/{id}/reveal` (requires secrets:edit,
emits `secret.revealed`, plaintext returned exactly once). Reveal
payloads carry no provenance detail beyond the title — provenance
queries never carry the secret.

fields.description: field_key → plaintext for every sealed field.

SecretShareLink.description:
A one-time share link row (`secret_share_links`, migration 0096).
The token NEVER round-trips here: the DB stores a SHA-256 hash and
the raw token exists exactly once, inside the create response
(`SecretShareLinkCreated`). Scoped to the org, expiring by
`expires_at`, single-use by construction (transactional claim),
audited through `audit_events` at every lifecycle step.

consumed_at.description:
Consumed exactly once: the claim's stamp; `consumed_by` is the
claiming org user (the claimer must belong to the sharing org).

expires_at.description:
Long absolute URL is composed client-side off the claim token;
responses here carry none of it.

revoked_at.description:
Non-NULL only while the link is dead-by-creator (revoked links
can never have been consumed — the row CHECK keeps the pair
exclusive).

subject_kind.description:
Which vault subject the link shares (ids/title only — never the
material).

SecretShareLinkIssued.description:
The create response — the ONLY place the raw token exists on the
wire; the URL is resolved by the web app at `/{app}/share?token=…`.
(Named `Issued` because `SecretShareLinkCreated` is the domain-EVENT
payload's struct; this is the HTTP response.)

link_path.description: Composed from the token: `?token=...` for the consumer surface.

token.description:
The one-time token, verbatim — never stored server-side (SHA-256
only).

SegmentEnd.description:
Why a timer segment ended. Preserved forever — the pause reason is
billable-work metadata, not a transient UI state.

uptime_kuma.description:
Uptime Kuma's status-page UI (Wave 34 claims close-out: the section
2 observability row that had not shipped). Same link-out shape as
Grafana — a standalone operator UI in the observability profile
that Marula never reads from, so the pane can only offer the link
and never report on it.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key.

open_invoices.description: Open invoices on the statement (number, due date, outstanding).

queued_to.description:
Addresses the statement email was queued to (client contacts
with an address). The message rides the outbound ledger; in
none-mode transport it stays queued like every other leg.

total_outstanding_minor.description: Sum outstanding across the statement, minor units.

cert_fingerprint.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the pinned client certificate.

created_by.description: The enrolling principal's id (the human admin), if a human enrolled it.

revocation_reason.description: Admin-supplied reason recorded at revocation, if any.

loops.description:
The raw `/healthz` body when the service speaks JSON (the worker's
per-loop liveness flags ride here); null otherwise.

current.description: True for the session making the request.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive.

na.description:
Shared not-applicable state (Wave 12 lane 6): `true` marks the item
N-A as ORG-WIDE server truth and clears the checkmark (the states
are mutually exclusive; checked semantics are untouched for callers
that omit it — legacy payloads default to `false` and behave
exactly as before). N-A REQUIRED items are exempt from pre-close
enforcement and derived progress.

note_reason.description:
Server-composed ledger reason (Wave 17 lane 11, §5.1): MANDATORY
(non-empty, ≤2000 chars) when this call sets N-A (na: true) or
reverses a terminal state (reopen); ignored for plain checks. The
reason text lands in the ledger as the auto-appended internal note
composed and inserted in THIS transaction — never a client-side
second post.

domain.description:
The custom domain to claim (e.g. `support.msp.example.com`). Stored
normalized (lowercased, trailing dot stripped).

SetCustomDomainResponse.description: POST response: exactly the three fields TASKLIST A8 (B) names.

depends_on.description:
The FULL finish-to-start dependency set for the task (PUT
semantics): every id must be a task of the same project; the set
must not create a cycle (typed 422 names the offending edge).

verified.description: true = admin-stamped verification; false = revokes the stamp.

rank.description: Explicit queue position: 0 sorts first among overrides.

edges.description:
The complete allowed matrix. Empty list returns the board to
floor-mode governance.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.

role.description: Builtin org role preset: owner, admin, dispatcher, senior_tech, technician, bookkeeper, auditor, read_only.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + version.

active.description: `false` deactivates: sessions revoked, login blocked. Never deletes.

SettingKind.description:
The value shapes the registry understands. A stored value must satisfy
its declaration's kind or the write is rejected (validation is applied
before persistence, never after).

oneOf.description: Inclusive integer range.
Free text with a hard length cap.

value.description: Free text with a hard length cap.

oneOf.description: Closed choice set; the wire value is the option string itself.

SettingValue.description:
A concrete setting value. Only three payload types exist by design —
richer structures are entities, not settings.

ShareClaimMaterial.description:
The unified claim response: the material exactly once (the claim
consumes the link). Mirrors `SecretReveal` / `PasswordReveal`
contents under one shape — `fields` carries `field_key` → plaintext.

ShareSubjectKind.description:
Which vault subject a share link or rotation refers to. One-time
share links cover BOTH the native secret records and the legacy byte-
compatible password entries; rotation mirrors the same pair.

carrier.description: Optional carrier + tracking ref (deeplinked by later lanes).

ticket_id.description: The on-site job the shipment belongs to.

SignOff.description:
The evidence row. Immutable by design: there is no UPDATE path, so a
correction is a second row linked by `supersedes_sign_off_id`.

attachment_id.description:
The PNG payload in the content-addressed store (`kind = sign_off`).
`None` exactly when the signer agreed by typing their name instead of
drawing, which is the first-class alternative path rather than a
degenerate capture.

captured_at.description:
Device-clock reading when the stroke finished, recorded verbatim —
offline capture is the normal case, so this is evidence about the
device, not a trusted server timestamp.

consent_text_snapshot.description:
Verbatim text the signer agreed to. Snapshot, not a live join, so a
later consent revision can never change what an earlier signer agreed.

consent_version.description: Consent wording version the signer saw.

idempotency_key.description: Client-minted, server-enforced unique per org (offline replay lands once).

signer_name.description: Who signed, as they typed it. A drawn mark identifies nobody on its own.

supersedes_sign_off_id.description: Set only on a correction row; points backward at the original.

ticket_id.description: The ticket being signed off. A sign-off always has one subject.

typed_agreement.description:
True when the signer agreed by typing their name. An auditor needs to
know which captures carried ink, because the two are not equally
strong evidence and only one can be compared against a sample.

witnessed_by_user_id.description: The staff member who presented the pad and watched the signature.

SignOffConsent.description: Append-only consent wording per org. Revision N+1 never rewrites revision N.

SignOffRevocation.description:
One entry in a sign-off's revocation trail. The row and its bytes survive;
"is revoked" is answered by the existence of one of these.

seq.description:
1-based per sign-off; a second revocation of the same sign-off is a
data error, not an overwrite.

SignOffSignerKind.description:
Who drew the mark. `PortalClient` is RESERVED: the API rejects it today so
a future portal-signing lane needs no schema change, mirroring the reserved
`Attachment::uploaded_by_portal_user_id` column.

attachment_filename.description:
Payload facts (filename/content type/size/sha256), never the bytes.
All `None` on a typed agreement, which has no mark to describe.

oneOf.description: The most recent revocation, when the sign-off has been revoked.

superseded_by.description: The id of a correction that replaced this one, when one exists.

SignOffView.description:
A sign-off plus the facts a client renders on the timeline: the payload's
storage facts, the current revocation state, and the correction relation.

overlapping_runs.description:
Issued runs overlapping this window — a WARNING, not a block:
re-running an overlapping window is a real operator need, but
it must never be silent.

run_id.description: The run that claimed this sign-off, when one has.

mode.description: `shadow` rows are recorded but drive nothing (no rerank applied).

relates.description:
The `relates` Noul probability, when the decision edge answered.
`None` = the edge went quiet (unconfigured/downed) for that
candidate.

retrieval_score.description:
Blended lexical relevance from the Postgres index (higher is
better) — the retrieval rank that fed the reranker.

state.description:
Threshold classification of the live answer: "act" | "pending" |
"ignore". `None` when no answer, shadow mode, or no thresholds.

q.description:
Override the retrieval text (defaults to the ticket's own title
plus a body excerpt). Clamped like the search surface.

query.description: The retrieval query executed (the ticket's own title/body text).

latitude.description: lat/lon in decimal degrees for routing/travel estimates.

SkillCatalogEntry.description:
GET /api/dispatch/skills envelope entry: the org skill catalog with
holder counts (`active` = non-expired as of now).

SkillInput.description: One entry of a skill replacement set.

expires_at.description: Certification expiry; must be in the future when present.

skill.description: Org skill vocabulary, 1..=80 chars after trimming.

slug.description:
When present, every version of this slug (newest first) instead of
the latest version of each slug.

SkillManifest.description:
The declarative skill manifest (docs/10-agent-platform.md §4:
`AgentSkill` — version, capabilities, prompts/rules). Content is
UNTRUSTED RAG-class data: consumption-time layering quotes and scopes
it into rules layers; nothing here is ever executed as instructions.

capabilities.description:
Agent capability scopes the skill REQUESTS (data for the consent
surface; enforcement stays in the agent platform's rule layers).

prompts.description: Prompt snippets — quoted verbatim at consumption time.

rules.description: Rules snippets — quoted verbatim at consumption time, deny wins.

expires_at.description: Certification expiry; absent = does not expire.

SlaCalendar.description:
An org-level business-hours calendar row (`sla_calendars`). The math
type is [`BusinessCalendar`]; this carries its identity.

calendar.description:
Flattened calendar body (timezone/windows/holidays/maintenance);
`calendar.name` mirrors `name` on write.

notify_user_ids.description:
Extra recipients from the ladder step; the assignee is added
server-side.

title.description: Human-facing headline, e.g. "[MAR-12] SLA risk on resolution".

SpecFilter.description: One spec filter: catalog column + operator + typed operand.

column.description:
Column name from the view's FILTERABLE inventory (the narrower v1
allowlist — filtered-but-unselected columns surprise consumers).

oneOf.description: Required exactly when the operator takes a value.

Org MFA policy applies to federated logins (Wave 13 lane 7):
complete via POST /api/auth/mfa/verify with the bridge token.

template_id.description:
Optional saved field-mapping template applied at STAGE time, so the
stored chunk is already in canonical columns.

StageChunkRequest.description:
POST /imports/batches/{id}/stage request: uploads ONE chunk of rows to
the ObjectStore under a deterministic key without executing anything.

chunk_index.description: Index of the chunk just staged (its deterministic key suffix).

staged_chunks.description: Total staged chunks after this upload — the worker's runbook length.

artifact_url.description:
Optional release-asset URL for B2 cross-digest verification of
the actual artifact bytes (same posture as the registry source).

commit.description: Pinned 40-hex commit the tag resolves to.

tag.description: Pinned git tag — HEAD is refused, never accepted.

artifact_url.description:
Optional direct artifact URL (marketplace CDN / release asset).
When present the server RE-FETCHES the bytes and verifies their
sha256 against the catalog-pinned digest BEFORE the staged row
exists (B2 cross-digest verification; typed
`distribution_digest_invalid` on mismatch).

artifact_digest.description:
The claimed sha256 for community pulls — reverified against the
re-fetched bytes before the row exists.

fetched_ref.description: The pinned reference (a version tag / commit for community pulls).

manifest.description:
The inline manifest for `manual_upload` (community origins are
re-fetched server-side instead).

StageType.description:
The kind of a pipeline stage. `won` / `lost` are terminal outcomes;
deals on such a stage are closed.

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key. Absent in
legacy clients — purely additive. (Creates carry no version.)

StatementLine.description: One open invoice on the statement.

StockItemView.description:
The stock item as the CALLER may see it. `last_unit_cost_minor` is
financial data — `null` without `financial:read` (RB2, ADR 0004).

StockLevelView.description: POST thresholds response: the fresh threshold row.

StockMovementView.description: Movement view (the traceability row the reads render).

fx_rate_used.description: ADR 0002 receipt FX lock fields (`null` for in-base movements).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key + entity
version. Absent in legacy clients — purely additive. A retried stop
replays the original time entry instead of failing "no active timer".

session_id.description: Omit to stop the caller's active timer.

unbillable_reason.description:
Typed unbillable reason (Wave 39 V3) — required by validation
when `billable` is false.

work_type.description:
Category slug (Wave 39 V5): keys onto the org's time_categories
taxonomy; additive — legacy clients omit it and the entry stays
honestly unclassified.

note.description: Optional free-text context recorded on the decision trail.

SubmitResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the full entry snapshot
(including its new approval state) plus the decision trail entry.

answer.description:
Raw answer entry: kind + picked/level/probability + the FULL
normalized distribution + confidence (no prose — none exists).

state.description:
"act" | "pending" | "ignore" — the threshold gate at read time.
`None` when no thresholds resolve (honest unconfigured state).

available.description:
False in NONE mode — suggestion-grade features require a measured
provider (ADR 0010 visibly-absent posture).

mode.description: `shadow` rows drive nothing and are labeled as such.

agent_description.description:
A2: model-facing prose beside the human label. What makes LLM
authoring cheap enough to be the default.

oneOf.description:
A2: who sees this entry. Undeclared stays `human`, so a plugin that
declares nothing never joins the LLM tool catalogue.

description.description: One-line description shown in the editor and on consent.

effect.description: The consented effect the engine executes.

emits.description:
A2: the event types this action can produce. Load-bearing: the
static loop refusal reads them, and a plugin that emits
`ticket.status_changed` then waits for it would otherwise deadlock
a workflow. Validated against the event-type registry at grant
time.

idempotent.description:
A2: repeating-safety. Defaults to false, because an undeclared
plugin action's retry-safety is unknown — `flow.retry` and the
operator retry both refuse a false until a plugin says otherwise.

label.description: Label shown in the automations editor.

output_schema.description:
A2 (Wave 43 lane 13, `p43-node-registry`): what the action
RETURNS. Before this field a workflow could call a plugin action
but could not use what came back, which made a plugin node a
dead end for every downstream condition and reference.

params_schema.description: Optional JSON-Schema subset for the action's params.

SurfaceActionEffect.description:
The built-in EFFECT a declared automation action maps onto. Closed
vocabulary: the rule engine executes the effect with the action's
validated params — the plugin contributes the kind, never custom
execution.

SurfaceEntryView.description: One registered entry as the web consumes it.

label.description: Label shown in the board field editor.

schema.description: The JSON-Schema subset applied to the field's value on write.

SurfaceRead.description:
One declared READ node (Wave 43 lane 4, ADR 0017 §5).

`automation_action` is write-shaped, so before this kind a workflow
could not FETCH from an external system at all — which is exactly the
gap that stopped a workflow assembling Decision Engine context from an
RMM. A read is therefore the one kind whose guardrails are STRICTER
than a write's, and they are declared per entry rather than defaulted:
a loop over devices is a denial of service aimed at the customer's own
external system, and a device list of ten thousand must not grow the
run ledger by megabytes.

agent_description.description: A2: model-facing prose beside the human label.

oneOf.description: A2: who sees this entry. Undeclared stays `human`.

description.description: One-line description shown in the editor and on consent.

emits.description:
A2: the event types this read can produce. A read produces none of
its own, so this is normally empty; declaring one makes the loop
refusal able to see it.

guardrails.description:
The caps this read runs under. Required — a read without declared
guardrails refuses, so there is no silent unbounded default.

idempotent.description:
A2 (Wave 43 lane 13): repeating-safety. False by default — a read
is rate-capped precisely because a loop over devices is cheap to
write, and retrying one is the same loop.

label.description: Label shown in the automations editor's read picker.

output_schema.description:
Optional JSON-Schema subset describing what comes back, so a
downstream node can use it.

params_schema.description:
Optional JSON-Schema subset for the read's parameters (what the
caller supplies — never credentials, which the host resolves).

label.description: Label shown in the report builder.

SurfaceSlot.description: Where a declared widget may render. Closed vocabulary.

SurfaceTrigger.description:
One declared TRIGGER source (Wave 43 lane 4, ADR 0017 §3): the event
type a plugin emits, which a rule can then fire on.

The trigger is a DECLARATION, not a dispatcher. It names the type it
emits and the schema the emitted payload satisfies; the engine's
matching decides what fires. `emitted_event_type` is validated against
the event-type registry (migration 0124) at grant time, so a plugin
cannot declare a type the platform does not know and the org has not
admitted.

description.description: One-line description shown in the editor and on consent.

emitted_event_type.description:
The event type this source publishes (`segment.segment`, the same
grammar the platform's own types use, e.g. `rmm.device_offline`).
Checked against the event-type registry at grant time.

label.description: Label shown in the automations editor's trigger picker.

payload_schema.description:
Optional JSON-Schema subset the emitted envelope's payload
satisfies, so a rule author knows what they can read.

default_props.description: Optional defaults applied under props_schema before render.

id.description:
Plugin-local id, `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}`. The registry key is
`plugin.<install-slug>.<id>` — collision-free by construction.

props_schema.description:
Optional JSON-Schema subset the widget's per-board props must
satisfy (same subset as settings_schema).

title.description: Human label shown on the widget chrome and the consent screen.

SurfaceWidgetKind.description:
What a declared widget RENDERS AS. Closed vocabulary — each kind maps
onto one trusted core component; a plugin cannot introduce a new
render shape.

force.description: Force a poll even when the connection is disabled (admin repair).

outcome.description: The apply counters, wire-shaped (SyncOutcome is an internal struct).

Tag.description: An org-wide tag: a flat named label with an optional display color.

TagView.description: One tag + how many tickets currently carry it.

TargetStatusOption.description:
One target-board status option inside a `board_move_status_conflict`
409 — everything the client needs to render the pick list.

TaskGateItem.description:
One unassigned task on the close gate's typed 409 (§4.1): the row the
UI must resolve (Option A batch-close / Option B manual work) — decision
text, and whether it is a REQUIRED template item (enforcement pill).

TaskStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a task. `completed` is reached ONLY through the dedicated
complete endpoint, which enforces dependency readiness and emits the
completion (+ milestone billing seam) events.

ticket_references.description:
How many tickets still reference the node (informational —
retirement does not require zero references).

TaxonomyMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the node plus read-your-write
metadata.

TaxonomyNodeView.description:
One taxonomy node (type or category). `parent_id` is null for types and
root categories; subcategories carry their parent.

from.description: Inclusive window start (default: today's UTC midnight minus 1 day).

TeamScorecardsResponse.description: The team view: one scorecard per staff member, owner/admin only.

TechnicianCapacity.description: One technician across the whole horizon.

total_travel_minutes.description: Sum of leg minutes actually estimated for this day.

TechnicianView.description:
One technician column: capacity stats plus everything the board draws
in the column (bookings, on-call, exclusions, availability windows).

available_minutes.description:
Working minutes covered by availability windows minus exclusions
over the day window (`core_domain::scheduling::covered_minutes`).

booked_minutes.description: Union of live booking minutes clipped to the day window.

utilization_percent.description: 0–100+, where >100 is over-capacity (the Ember warning state).

TemplateKindVocabulary.description:
The closed variable vocabulary for one kind (editor UX + validation
source of truth: `core_domain::templates::variables_for_kind`).

active_only.description: Defaults to true: the pickers only ever want live templates.

TemplateView.description:
One template row: a shipped default (`is_system` + `builtin`), a fork
(`forked_from`), or an org-created template.

builtin.description: Shipped preset tag, `null` for org-created rows.

forked_from.description: For a forked copy: the origin's builtin tag.

is_system.description:
Shipped defaults are system data: immutable, restorable, never
editable or deletable in place — orgs fork.

vocabulary.description: The closed per-kind variable vocabulary, for editors: kind → keys.

TestConnectionRequest.description: Request to test the connection to an AI provider.

provider.description: Provider to test. If omitted, tests the currently active provider in settings.

TestConnectionResponse.description: Result of testing an AI provider connection.

message.description: Descriptive status message or reason on failure.

event_id.description: The envelope id to look for in the delivery log.

to.description: Where the probe goes; absent sends to the caller's own address.

outcome.description:
`queued` — the worker performs the actual send; the delivery ledger
carries the outcome (never a fake synchronous "sent" here).

ThemePackView.description:
One installed theme pack for the org. The `manifest` carries the FULL
validated manifest snapshot (token overrides only); the ACTIVE pack
is identified through the typed `appearance.theme` setting value
`pack:<slug>`, not this table.

active.description:
Present when this pack is the org's active theme (i.e. the
typed `appearance.theme` setting names `pack:<slug>`).

category.description: Denormalized from the board status for cheap filtering/sorting.

merged_into_ticket_id.description:
Merge marker (Wave 11 lane 9): the survivor this ticket folded
into, when it was absorbed by a merge. The row stays queryable
(doctrine #9) but is closed and never re-opened.

type_id.description:
Classification (Wave 11 lane 3; read-view exposure Wave 12 lane 6):
the org taxonomy nodes carried on the ticket. PATCH accepts them;
the read view now returns them so ticket detail can display the
current classification. Purely descriptive — classification-only
doctrine (§5) binds behavior to semantic categories, never these.

TicketBoardMoveResponse.description: Same additive envelope as the status endpoint (plain ticket body).

TicketChecklistBatchResponse.description:
Batch response: full updated checklist view + the appended notes in
item order so the client reconciles in one round trip.

TicketChecklistMutationResponse.description:
Same additive envelope for checklist writes: the full checklist view at
the top level (unchanged shape) plus the read-your-write metadata for
the affected item. `appended_note` carries the server-composed ledger
note when the transition wrote one (§3.3/§3.4) — absent otherwise.

TicketChecklistView.description:
GET response for a ticket's checklist: instances, derived progress,
and the board's live enforcement posture. `blocking` lists the unchecked
REQUIRED items when enforcement is active (empty otherwise).

TicketComment.description:
A structured ticket note. Taxonomy: internal / client-visible /
in-house update. `kind` gates portal visibility and email fan-out.

workflow_meta.description:
Server-composed workflow-note provenance (Wave 17 lane 11,
migration 0080): `{kind, auto, item_ids}` on notes the server
appended for task-state transitions; NULL/unsent for every
user-written note. Machine marking lives HERE, never in body text
(spoofable, unqueryable). Additive-only contract: absent keys
deserialize to None.

TicketCommentMutationResponse.description: Same additive envelope for comments (plain comment body).

fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: purchase entry) —
set once at entry when currency ≠ org base; immutable afterwards.

invoice_line_id.description: Set once this line became an invoice line ("billed once, ever").

TicketCustomFieldValue.description: One stored ticket value with its definition context.

oneOf.description: Outbound send lifecycle; `null` for inbound rows.

reply_to_message_id.description:
The id of the message INSIDE THIS TICKET this row replies to,
resolved case-insensitively against the ledger's Message-IDs.
`null` when the parent is unknown or lives on another ticket.

TicketEmailRow.description:
One ledger message as the timeline renders it: the full `EmailMessage`
shape (unchanged, additive only) plus the delivery projection and the
resolved in-ticket reply parent.

messages.description: Newest-first, mirroring the ledger's thread view.

TicketExpense.description: One expense entry on a ticket.

fx_rate_used.description:
FX conversion snapshot (ADR 0002 lock moment: expense entry) —
set once at entry when currency ≠ org base; immutable afterwards.

TicketFieldInput.description:
One value assignment on a ticket create/patch: raw JSON validated against
its definition server-side.

TicketLinkType.description:
A typed edge between two tickets.

- `ParentChild`: `from_ticket_id` is the CHILD, `to_ticket_id` the
  parent — child work rolls up to the parent.
- `MajorIncident`: `from_ticket_id` is a MEMBER, `to_ticket_id` the
  major incident it folded into.

cursor.description:
Keyset cursor (Wave 15 lane 3): the opaque `x-next-cursor` value
from the previous page's last row. Resumes the ranked list
strictly after that row — deep pages stop paying O(offset) scan
cost (docs/perf.md F2). When present, `offset` is ignored.

tags.description:
Comma-separated tag ids (Wave 11 lane 9): AND semantics — tickets
must carry every listed tag.

candidates.description: Active technicians sorted best-first (fewest missing, then name).

TicketMatch.description:
Skills-matched staffing for one unassigned ticket. Tickets with no
required skills are not listed (the plain queue ordering covers them).

TicketMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): the enriched ticket fields at the
top level (unchanged shape) plus the additive `mutation` metadata — the
applied snapshot, monotonic per-entity `seq`/`version`, and the prior
and new values that make undo a core capability.

TicketNumber.description:
Human-facing ticket number, e.g. `MAR-2841`. Globally unique per org,
assigned from a per-org sequence.

TicketRevertResponse.description:
The reverted ticket with the mutation envelope, plus what was reverted.
Deserializable so an IF1 idempotent replay can reconstruct the exact
stored response.

TicketRollup.description:
Rollup over the children/members pointing at one ticket, plus the
ticket's own billable money lines.

billable_cost_minor.description: Summed minor-unit total of billable cost lines + expenses.

child_open_count.description: Open (not closed, not merged) children still carrying work.

time_minutes.description: Summed minutes of folded-in time (own + children/members).

TicketSlaState.description:
Per-ticket SLA clock state. Accumulates paused business seconds so a
Waiting stretch does not consume the resolution budget.

paused_business_secs.description: Business seconds accumulated while the clock was paused.

paused_since.description: When the current pause began (None while running).

TicketSlaStatus.description: Live SLA clock readout for one ticket (badge + countdown surfaces).

applied.description:
False when no SLA policy applies to the ticket — a typed empty
state, never a 404 (the endpoint is polled by the ticket header).

minutes_remaining.description: Business minutes left on the resolution budget (negative = over).

paused.description: True while a Waiting-category pause is open.

TicketStatusCategory.description:
The four semantic categories every ticket status maps to (§5).
Customization (labels, ordering, per-board sets) can never add, remove, or
re-bind these: SLA timers, pause logic, automations, billing, and reports
bind to the category, not the label.

TicketStatusMutationResponse.description: Same additive envelope for status transitions (plain ticket body).

TicketWithFields.description: A ticket payload enriched with its custom-field values (detail + list).

TimeApprovalAction.description:
The audit-trail action of a [`TimeEntryApprovalRecord`] (append-only
decision trail; differs from [`ApprovalAction`] in that it names the
recorded past, not the requested transition).

TimeCategory.description:
An org's semantic time category (Wave 39 V4). Entries key their
`work_type` column onto `slug`; the T&M rate card keys
`contract_rates.work_type` onto the same slugs. Renames change the
label only — slugs are stable forever.

default_billable.description: Billing default applied at capture time.

position.description: Admin-managed display order; capture surfaces sort by it.

rate_card_affinity.description:
Hint that T&M card rows key onto this slug (admin documentation;
the card itself stays contract-owned).

requires_unbillable_reason.description:
When true, flipping billable off demands a typed
[`UnbillableReason`] first (validated in the domain + API).

retired.description: Soft retire: pickers drop retired categories, entries keep them.

slug.description: Lowercase snake_case semantic key. `work_type` values are these.

description.description: Some → set (null clears); absent → no change.

retired.description:
Un-retire a soft-retired category. `Some(false)` restores it to
the pickers; retirement is reversible because entries and rate
cards keep the slug.

entry_count.description: Live count of entries carrying this slug (settings usage read).

TimeEntry.description:
A durable, reviewable record of worked time. Created from a timer session
or entered manually; subject to bulk review and approval workflows.

approval_reason_code.description:
Typed rejection reason (the [`TimeRejectionReason`] wire code) when
the entry was rejected; cleared on resubmit.

approval_status.description:
Approval lifecycle state. `None` on legacy snapshots (pre-approval
rows and old event payloads) and treated as [`ApprovalStatus::Draft`]
by the workflow; new writes always carry the status.

minutes.description: Worked seconds — authoritative, derived on write, never recomputed.

phase_id.description:
The delivery phase this entry scopes to (project-scoped entries
only; implies the project). `None` on ticket-scoped entries.

ticket_id.description:
The ticket this entry bills through. `None` ONLY on project-scoped
entries (Wave 39 lane 4, report P5): the entry scopes to
[`phase_id`](Self::phase_id) instead and bills through the phase
project's linked contract — project work pays without a ticket
detour. Exactly one of (ticket_id, phase_id) is present; the DB
CHECK mirrors it.

timer_session_id.description: Origin: timer-derived entries keep their session for audit.

unbillable_reason.description:
Typed unbillable reason (the [`UnbillableReason`] wire code) —
required when `billable` is false; null on billable entries.

TimeEntryAdjustment.description:
One verification edit on one entry's billed minutes (Wave 39 V2).
Additive-ledger: the original entry row is never rewritten for
billing — the run sums `(entry.minutes + Σ delta_minutes)`. The
signed delta is ≤ 0 (verification can only reduce or zero); the
reason is the evidence (V9) and is NOT NULL at the DB level.

original_minutes.description: Denormalized evidence: minutes BEFORE the adjustment.

run_id.description:
The run this adjustment rides, when it was made during a run's
close flow; `None` when made from the standalone workspace.

TimeEntryApprovalRecord.description:
One append-only approval decision (the audit row behind the queue's
history view). `seq` is monotonic per entry — the client's ordering key.

reason_code.description: Typed [`TimeRejectionReason`] wire code on rejections, else None.

TimeEntryMutationResponse.description: Same additive envelope for the stop flow (time-entry body).

TimeEntryQueueItem.description:
A queue/history projection: the entry plus its approval metadata
(who/when submitted, who/when decided).

locked.description: True once the entry is consumed by an invoice — frozen forever.

oneOf.description:
The ticket's human number (`18366`) and title, so the queue can lead
with "#18366 Disable leaver accounts" instead of a uuid prefix. A
person reads a ticket number; they do not read an id. Absent for
project-scoped entries, which have no ticket at all.

TimeEntryTicketRef.description: The ticket an entry bills through, named for a human reader.

client_name.description:
The client the ticket belongs to, when it is known. `None` for a
ticket with no client yet — the row then shows no client rather than
an empty one.

TimeRejectionReason.description:
Closed rejection vocabulary (Wave 14 lane 1): approvers reject with a
machine-readable reason code, never prose-only. `other` may carry the
free-text explanation on the decision record.

eod_nudge_hour.description: Local hour (member timezones) the EOD audit fires at.

time_gap_min_minutes.description: Active days logging under this many minutes are gap days.

TimeVerdict.description: One verdict: what is odd, said in words, plus the fix beside it.

label.description:
The mark's words, typed and short: "Vague description",
"Overlaps #18355 by 30 min", "Longer than usual, 2:00 vs 0:45".

TimeVerdictFix.description:
A remedy, carrying the value it applies so the client never has to
recompute it (and cannot apply a different one than the server meant).

label.description:
Button text, in the pack's voice: "Use suggestion", "Trim 30m",
"Ask the tech".

suggested_description.description:
Set for [`TimeVerdictFixKind::UseSuggestion`]: the exact description
to write. Assembled from the ticket title and the work type.

trim_minutes.description:
Set for [`TimeVerdictFixKind::TrimMinutes`]: whole minutes to cut,
always positive and never more than the entry holds.

TimeVerdictFixKind.description: The one action that clears a verdict.

TimeVerdictKind.description:
What is wrong with an entry. A closed set: an open string here would put
model prose on a money surface, which is exactly what the pack forbids.

TimerMutationResponse.description:
Instant-first mutation response (IF2): session fields at the top level
(unchanged shape) plus the additive `mutation` metadata.

TimerSegment.description: A contiguous running interval within a timer session.

ended_at.description: None while this segment is running.

reason.description: Free-text reason recorded at pause time ("on call with vendor").

TimerSession.description:
One user's timer against one ticket. At most one session per user is
ever running — enforced by [`TimerSession::start_switch`].

TokenPair.description: Token pair returned by all auth flows.

overdue.description: Derived: open past the due date.

client_id.description: Open loan client, when the unit is on a client loan.

holder_user_id.description: Open checkout holder, when the unit is checked out.

is_tool.description: True when the item is a flagged tool (checkout-eligible).

overdue.description: Derived: checked-out past due, or loaned past its expected return.

overdue_only.description: Only units past their checkout due date or loan expected return.

tool_only.description: `true` = tools only; `false` = devices only; absent = both.

code.description: Current TOTP code or a recovery code.

otpauth_url.description: Standard otpauth:// URI (renderable as QR by clients).

secret_base32.description: Base32 secret for manual authenticator entry. Shown exactly once.

duration.description: The audio duration the provider reports, when it sends one.

surface.description: The typed surface the call rode (always `transcription` here).

allOf.description:
Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1): idempotency key +
If-Match `version`.

action.description:
`approve|reject|cancel`. `billed` is run-owned only (never a
manual write — the invoice run flips it with the invoice link).

TransitionEdge.description:
One directed edge in a board's explicit transition matrix. Both ids must
belong to statuses of the SAME board (enforced here, and by composite FKs
in storage).

TravelDraftMutationResponse.description:
Mutation envelope: draft fields at the top level plus the additive
`mutation` metadata (IF2).

appointment_id.description:
Wave 32 lane 7: the planned appointment this trip reconciles
against, when linked.

expense_id.description:
Wave 32 lane 7: the expense this draft's mileage produced, once
reimbursed.

TravelOrigin.description:
The resolved journey start point a travel estimate ran from (Wave 32
lane 7). Snapshotted onto the appointment so the estimate stays
explainable after the start point or the site changes.

source.description:
How it was resolved: `explicit` (dispatcher-set day start) or
`previous_day_site` (auto-suggested continuity).

error.description: Set when the lookup itself failed (no resolver, transport error).

matched.description:
Whether an observed TXT string equalled the issued token (the
authority for verification).

observed.description: Every TXT string observed at the record name.

UnavailableMetric.description:
A metric the core does not report, and why. The reason is prose for a
HUMAN operator reading the surface; `metric` is the stable token a
dashboard can group on.

UnbillableReason.description:
Why an entry is not billable (report V3). Typed values only — the
verification run and scoring reports aggregate on these codes.

UndoFieldStep.description: One field of one applied write — per-field undo granularity.

new_value.description: Value after the write (absent keys read as `null`).

prior.description: Value before the write (absent keys read as `null`).

UndoMode.description:
The record's undo posture: `open` = near-total undo; `reverts_only` =
explicit actioned per-field reverts only (record is closed).

limit.description:
Maximum steps / field rows returned (1–200, default 50). Newest
first; the first step's `seq` is the record's current version.

current_version.description: The record's current version — echo it as `version` on a revert.

UndoStep.description: One applied write on the record — one step of the undo stack.

restorable.description:
The revert path can restore this write's prior values (`create`
steps are visible history but not value-restorable).

seq.description: Per-entity monotonic write number (the version this write produced).

write_id.description: Trail row id (stable reference for actioned reverts).

UniformOk.description: The uniform shape every request surface returns.

UnitBasis.description:
Which org inventory counts a per-unit contract's quantity at
evaluation time (C: quantity × unit price per period, unit counts
drawn from the org's asset/user inventories at evaluation).

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

category_id.description: `null` clears the category; omit to leave it untouched.

content_jsonb.description:
Canonical rich content (ADR 0007); validated on every write. The
editor's debounced autosave rides THIS field over the instant-first
envelope (IF1–IF3 unchanged: idempotency key + version/If-Match).

allOf.description: Instant-first mutation parameters (IF1).

oneOf.description:
Inventory lifecycle inputs (rental tracking + depreciation);
absent = keep (patch semantics).

active.description: Reactivating an archived item is a plain update.

sku.description: Some → set (null clears); absent → no change.

UpdateCatalogItemRequest.description:
PATCH /api/catalog-items/{id} body. Absent fields keep their value;
`Some(None)` clears an optional field.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

UpdateDealRequest.description:
PATCH /api/pipeline/deals/{id} body — editable fields only; the stage
moves via the /stage leg.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

client_id.description: Absent = keep the current scope; explicit null moves to global.

fields.description: Absent = keep; present = validated against the (current) layout.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

article_id.description: `null` detaches the article; omit to leave it untouched.

options.description: Replaces the option set for choice kinds.

validator_entry_key.description:
§4.6: `Some(None)` clears the plugin validator; `Some(Some(key))`
sets it; absent leaves it untouched.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1/IF2).

`enabled` | `disabled` (the admin-enabled gate). `revoked` is
NOT settable here — revocation rides the dedicated revoke
surface so the audit trail names it.

version.description: Upgrade the pinned version (explicit, never automatic).

UpdateKitRequest.description: PATCH /api/tool-kits/{id} — absent fields keep their value.

barcode_token.description: Absent keeps the current token; `null` clears it (no barcode).

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

UpdateOrgDefaultRequest.description:
PUT /api/notification-org-defaults — replaces the org default ROW for
one kind; the chain is user override → org default → built-in, so an
untouched user's next email follows this policy. Quiet hours validate as
a paired `HH:MM` window in a real IANA timezone (422 otherwise).

quiet_from.description: `HH:MM` pair; both bounds together or neither.

Rotation schedule (Wave 19 lane 3): absent = keep; null = clear;
instant = set (stamps last_rotated_at in the same write).

Absent = keep the current secret; present (even empty string is
rejected) = rotate and archive the previous ciphertext to history.

current_version.description: Still running — the OLD version is pinned until consented.

PATCH /api/quotes/{id} body — draft-only. Absent fields keep their
value; `lines` present replaces the whole line list.

PUT /api/report-definitions/{id} body — full-replace semantics: every
member is applied; `description: null` clears it.

UpdateReportScheduleRequest.description:
PUT /api/report-schedules/{id} body — full-replace semantics; every
member is applied and the next-run preview recomputes.

gamification_opt_in.description:
R5's opt-in gamification toggle (streaks / leaderboards). Default
and privacy-preserving value: false.

allOf.description: Instant-first autosave parameters (IF1).

expires_at.description: absent = keep; null = clear; value = set.

Rotation schedule (Wave 19 lane 3): absent = keep; null = clear;
instant = set (stamps last_rotated_at in the same write).

scopes.description: Replacement grant set. Omitted ⇒ keep current grants.
